Reasons for changes in accounting policies and correction of accounting errors

On December 30, 2021, the Ministry of Finance issued the Notice on Issuing Interpretation No. 15 of Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (C.K. [2021] No. 35) (hereinafter referred to as "Document Interpretation No. 15"), which stipulated the accounting treatment of the external sales of  products  or  by-products  produced  by  enterprises  before  their  fixed  assets  reach  the  intended

usable state or during the research and development process, the related presentation on centralized management of funds, and the judgment on onerous contracts.

The  contents  in  Document  Interpretation  No.  15,  "Accounting  treatment  of  the  external  sales  of products or by-products produced by enterprises before their fixed assets reach the intended usable state or during the research and development process" and "Judgment on onerous contracts", were implemented as of  January 1, 2022. For details, please refer to the related announcement disclosed by the Company on  http://www.cninfo.com.cn on April 28, 2022.

On November 30, 2022, the Ministry of Finance issued the Notice on Issuing Interpretation No. 16 of Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (C.K. [2022] No. 31) (hereinafter referred to as "Document Interpretation No. 16"), which stipulated the "accounting treatment for deferred income tax relating to assets and liabilities arising from a single transaction that is not subject to the initial recognition  exemption",  "accounting  treatment  of  the  income  tax  effect  of  financial  instrumentrelated dividend classified by the issuer as equity instrument", and "accounting treatment of sharebased payment in cash settlement modified into share-based payment in equity settlement by the enterprise".

"Accounting treatment for deferred income tax relating to assets and liabilities arising from a single transaction that is not subject to the initial recognition exemption" in Document  Interpretation 16 came  into  force  as  of  January  1,  2023,  and  "accounting  treatment  of  the  income  tax  effect  of financial instrument-related dividend classified by the issuer as equity instrument" and "accounting treatment of share-based payment in cash settlement modified into share-based payment in equity settlement by the enterprise" took effect as of the date of declaration.

The lower of the net profits of the Company before and after non-recurring gains and losses were deducted was negative for the last three accounting years, and the auditor's report for the last year indicated doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

## Section III Management Discussion and Analysis

## I. Industry Overview for the Reporting Period

On  December  28,  2001,  Professor  Xu  Kaihua,  Founder  of  GEM,  established  the  Company  in Shenzhen based on the green ideal of "Green-Eco-Manufacture". The Company was then listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (Stock Code: 002340) and SIX Swiss Exchange, with a total share capital  of  5,136  million  shares,  net  assets  of  RMB18,474  million,  annual  yield  of  over  RMB30 billion and over 10,000 employees in total. The Company is the first in China to propose the green and  low-carbon  industrial  philosophy  of  "limited  resources,  unlimited  recycling".  It  actively advocates the business model of mining urban mines to "eliminate pollution and rebuild resources" and promote the development of a circular society. It is the forerunner of urban mining in China and the promoter of the world's new energy industry, as well as a pioneering group in the world's waste recycling industry, a core supplier of the world's new energy industry, and a leading enterprise of China's circular economy. The Company ranks No. 215 among China's Top 500 Patent Enterprises, No. 439 among China's Top 500 Manufacturing Enterprises, and No. 7 in the lists of "2022 Forbes China Top 50 Sustainable Development  Industrial Enterprises"  and  "2022  Hurun  China Top  100 Sustainable Development Private Enterprises".

Over the past 20 years, the Company has been adhering to the profit model of the principal business driven by "new energy materials manufacturing + urban mining" and propelling the achievement of carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality goals by forming a manufacturing model integrating resources recycling and use of clean energy materials.

The Company's principal business falls under the new energy industry and comprehensive waste resources  utilization  industry.  In  the  new  energy  industry,  the  Company  manufactures  ternary precursors for power batteries, ternary cathode materials and tricobalt tetraoxide for 3C batteries, and  is  a  leading  enterprise  in  the  global  new  energy  supply  chain.  In  the  comprehensive  waste resources  utilization  industry,  the  Company  recycles  and  treats  waste  power  batteries,  E-waste, scrap  vehicles,  waste  plastics  and  strategic  resources  of  nickel,  cobalt,  lithium  and  tungsten  and regenerates  scarce  resources  such  as  nickel,  cobalt,  lithium,  tungsten,  gold,  silver,  platinum  and palladium, and ultra-fine cobalt, nickel and tungsten powder materials and modified plastics. The Company's  principal  business,  "new  energy  materials  manufacturing  +  urban  mining",  not  only resonates with China's national development strategy but also fully conforms to the general trend of global  green  development  and  the  main  tone  of  carbon  emission  peak  and  carbon  neutrality, exhibiting the Company's massive potential in the market and broad prospects in the industry.

Backed by China's and the world's capital markets, the Company has built 19 waste recycling plants and new energy material manufacturing plants in 11 Chinese provinces and cities and South Africa, South Korea and Indonesia, spread its green development footprint across the world, over 40% of China's land area, and established cooperative relationship on waste treatment with over 500 million people, and is recycling and regenerating more than 30 kinds of scarce resources, including cobalt, nickel, lithium, copper, tungsten, gold, silver, platinum, palladium, rhodium, gallium, germanium, indium and rare earth.  Decommissioned power  batteries  and  E-waste  it  has  recycled  account  for more than 10% of China's total, nickel resources it has recycled account for 13% of the raw nickel mined in China, cobalt resources it has recycled and reused account for 340% of the cobalt tungsten mined in China, and tungsten resources it has recycled account for 6% of the raw tungsten mined in China.

In  recent  years,  GEM,  joining  hands  with  global  battery  factories  and  new  energy  vehicle manufacturers, has been actively developing a new energy whole-life-cycle value chain model of "battery recycling, resources regeneration, materials regeneration and battery pack

remanufacturing",  and  has  successively  built  six  power  battery  recycling  and  reusing  centers  in China and South Korea, effectively realizing cascade utilization of decommissioned power batteries and  complete  recovery  of  key  mineral  resources  such  as  lithium,  nickel  and  cobalt,  addressing global concerns about decommissioned  power  batteries and  promoting  global  new  energy development from "green" to "green".

In Indonesia, GEM has built the "Technology + Intelligence + Green" high-tech industrial park on nickel resources and new energy raw materials, the world's advanced innovation and research center on  metallurgical  engineering  technology,  and  the  world's  first  museum  on  the  nickel  resources industry, and cultivated a batch of mining engineering masters and other senior talents for Indonesia in  cooperation  with  Central  South  University,  which  has  become  a  highlight  project  of  cultural exchange and cooperation between China and Indonesia.

The Company has been awarded a number of national honors by the Chinese government, including China National Education Demonstration Base on Circular Economy, National Science Popularization Base on Ecology and Environment, National Education and Social Practice Base on Environment for Primary and Secondary Schools, National Green Factory, and National Demonstration Base on Urban Mining E-waste, and won the 2018 Davos Award for Global Circular Economy Multinational Company  and  the  2020  Paulson  Prize  for  Sustainable  Development  and Green  Innovation.  Moreover,  it  has  been  included  in  the  world-famous  magazine,  Nature,  as  a successful case of global waste recycling, listed by the UN as a demonstration enterprise of VOCs (volatile organic compounds) pollution reduction, and included the platform of leading enterprises of  the  world's  circular  economy.  It  has  driven  China's  circular  economy  to  go  global  as  an outstanding representative of China's circular society development and green development concepts, and made contributions to curbing the effect of greenhouse gases as a global best-practice enterprise representative that engages in green and low-carbon development.

In the future, GEM  will  uphold the green industrial strategy of "new  energy materials manufacturing + urban mining", carry out ESG value chain cooperation with global upstreams and downstreams, make the world circular, serve the world's new energy development and reduction of carbon dioxide emissions, build itself into a leader-level group of the global green and low-carbon industry, and create green value for global investors.

At  his  visit  to  GEM's  industrial  park  in  Wuhan  on  July  22,  2013,  General  Secretary  Xi Jinping  spoke  highly  of  GEM's  waste  recycling  model,  and  noted  that  "turning  waste  into treasure  and  recycling  is  a  sunrise  industry  to  turn  waste  into  resources  and  to  turn corruption  into  magic.  This  is  both  science  and  art.  I  hope  that  the  enterprise  will  make persistent efforts."

## i. Industry situation of the new energy material business

## 1. Power new energy material business

In 2022, amid the general trend of emission peak and carbon neutrality, green transport and clean energy  represented  by  new  energy  vehicles  showed  huge  industrial  prospects.  New  energy  has become a global windfall, and electrification is unstoppable.

In terms of industry policies, favorable policies continued to be introduced in 2022 to support the development  of  new  energy  vehicles.  In  August  2022,  the  Ministry  of  Industry  and  Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Ecology and Environment  issued  the Implementation  Plan  for  Carbon  Emission  Peak  and  in  the  Industrial Sector ,  in  which  it  is  proposed  to  vigorously  encourage  energy-saving  and  new  energy  vehicles, enhance technical innovation of whole-vehicle integration, improve the industrial concentration of

new  energy  vehicles,  speed  up  the  construction  of  charging  piles  and  innovation  in  electricity exchange  modes,  construct  a  convenient,  efficient  and  moderately  advanced  charging  network system, and make around 40% more vehicles powered by new energy and clean energy by 2030. In October 2022, the European Commission, the European Parliament and member states agreed to ban the production of new fuel-powered vehicles from 2035, and to reduce the carbon emissions of all new small cars and light commercial vehicles sold across the EU to zero. The introduction of this policy  guarantees  the  future  development  of  new  energy  vehicles  worldwide  in  an  institutional manner.

In terms of the status quo of market development, EVTank's White Paper on the Development of China's New Energy Vehicle Industry (2023) showed that a total of 10,824,000 new energy vehicles were sold worldwide in 2022, up 61.6% YoY, with the annual penetration rate exceeding 13%, up 4.7 percentage points from 2021. According to the statics of the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, the cumulative output of new energy vehicles in China in 2022 reached 7,058,000, up 96.9% YoY, and the cumulative sales volume reached 6,887,000, up 93.4% YoY, with an annual penetration rate of 27.6%, ranking first in the world for eight consecutive years. China Association of Automobile Manufacturers recently released the data on nationwide automobile production and sales from January to March 2023, according to which, a total of 1.65 million new energy vehicles were  produced  and  1,586,000  were  sold  in  China  from  January  to  March,  up  27.7%  and  26.2% respectively YoY and accounting for 26.1% of the market total. This suggests sustained explosive growth and strong development resilience of China's new energy vehicle market.

As the core component of  new energy vehicles,  the demand for power batteries is rising year by year.  According  to  the  statistics  of  China  Automobile  Battery  Innovation  Alliance,  in  2022,  the world's total installed capacity of power batteries was 513GWh, and China's was 294.6 GWh, up 90.7% YoY. In particular, the cumulative total installed capacity of ternary batteries was 110.4 GWh, accounting  for  37.5%  of  the  total,  up  48.6%  YoY  accumulatively,  and  the  same  of  lithium  iron phosphate  (LFP)  batteries  was  183.8  GWh,  accounting  for  62.4%  of  the  total,  up  130.2%  YoY accumulatively. Due to the sky-high price of lithium, the proportion of LFP production and sales continued to rise in  2022,  while that  of  ternary batteries  grew  sharply  by  48.6%,  suggesting  that there  will  not  be  any  change  in  the  trend  of  the  high-end  market's  requirement  for  high  energy density of batteries, and that high-nickel ternary batteries are the inevitable choice for 800km-range and  high-end  A-  and  B-class  new  energy  vehicles.  At  present,  the  price  of  lithium  has  dropped significantly to a reasonable price, and the new energy industry chain has entered the new stage of healthy development. The power battery market will continue to grow, and the proportion of ternary batteries in the new energy vehicle market will gradually increase upwards of 45%. It is estimated that in 2026, the world's total installed capacity of power batteries worldwide will reach 1,726 GWh, and China's will reach 710.4 GWh. According to Everbright Securities, the future capacity of the new energy vehicle market is expected to grow by over 10 times, and the global sales volume of new energy vehicles in 2025 is expected to exceed 23 million.

<!-- image -->

According to GGII, China shipped 1,125,000 tons of LFP in 2022, up over 130% YoY, and shipped 640,000 tons of ternary materials, up 47% YoY, in line with the development trend of new energy vehicles. In particular, ternary materials of the 8th generation and higher accounted for over 50%, and the market share of ternary materials of the 5th generation and lower decreased to less than 40%, showing the unstoppable nickelic trend of ternary materials. The future power battery material market will face two options: First, the production capacity may be differentiated, with insufficient high-end  production  capacity  and  excess  low-end  production  capacity,  and  second,  technical barriers  will  be  the  key  to  future  competition.  As  to  the  first  option,  power  battery  material enterprises  and  power  battery  enterprises  maintain  sound  cooperation  relationships,  and  it  is difficult for new participants to the market to have enough capacity to enter the high-end battery enterprise  supply  chain,  and  they  therefore  enter  the  mid-  and  low-end  battery  enterprise  supply chain, and may be overcapacity in the low-end market. As to the second option, technical barriers will  be  the  key  to  future  competition.  Therefore,  material  enterprises  with  industrial  chain cooperations and core technologies will win out.

## 2. 3C new energy material business

3C lithium-ion batteries are widely used around the world, and its market size is relatively stable, showing  a  rapid  development  trend  in  the  emerging  consumer  sector.  They  are  mainly  used  in mobile phones (including feature phones and smart phones), portable computers (including laptops and  tablet  computers)  and  all  smart  hardware  products  (including  wearable  devices,  drones, electronic cigarettes, and smart home, smart transport and smart healthcare devices). SPIR estimates that  global  shipments  of  3C  digital  lithium  batteries  will  reach  115.2  GWh  in  2025,  with  a compound growth rate of about 16% in the next four years.

Lithium  cobalt  oxide  (LCO)  is  the  earliest  commercialized  lithium  cathode  material,  and  is advantageous for high energy density, high discharge voltage, good filling and long cycle life. It has been widely used in 3C batteries. According to ICC, China's LCO output in 2022 was 77,000 tons, down 16% YoY, accounting for 91.7% of the global market, up 1.5% from the same period last year. In 2023, as China's economy recovers step by step, the output and sales volume of LCO will return to the normal level. ICC expects China's LCO output to maintain a 10% growth rate to 84,700 tons in 2023, and cobaltosic oxide, as the important raw material for LCO production, also to maintain steady growth in 2023.

## ii. Industry situation of the urban mining business

## 1. New energy recycling business

## (1) Power battery recycling

Power battery recycling is a global concern. It is not only an indispensable part of the sustainable development of the new energy industry, but also the key to the green and sustainable supply of strategic resources such as nickel, cobalt and lithium. It is also a strategic measure for addressing climate change and promoting green development.

China's  NPC  (National  People's  Congress)  and  CPPCC  (Chinese  People's  Political  Consultative Conference) held in 2023 highlighted the battery passport. The recycling, traceability and cascade utilization of power batteries and the recycling and reuse of key mineral resources, such as lithium, nickel and cobalt, are of great significance to ensure China's global competitiveness in the battery sector.  Zeng  Yuqun,  a  deputy  to  NPC  and  Chairman  of  CATL,  put  forward  in  the Proposal  on Carrying out Research on Power Battery Passport and Supporting Policies and Strengthening the Whole-Life-Cycle  Management  of  Battery  Products that  battery  passport  is  the  digital  twin  of physical batteries, and can empower the transparent digital management of the whole supply chain of power batteries. Battery passport allows consumers and regulators to access information about battery products in a simple and direct way and, as a strong measure for government regulation and social supervision, can serve as an important policy instrument to promote the low-carbon, circular and sustainable development of the battery industry. Proposals and suggestions on power battery recycling were frequently made during the NPC &amp; CPPCC period. Wang Qi, a deputy to NPC, held that it is necessary to further standardize the management mechanism for new energy vehicle power battery recycling, and establish the qualification criteria for power battery recycling enterprises. Tu Jianhua,  a  member  of  the  National  Committee  of  CPPCC,  suggested  active  exploration  of promoting  efficient  recycling  and  comprehensive  utilization  of  used  lithium  batteries  through "Internet  +  recycling".  Lu  Xindi,  a  deputy  to  NPC,  suggested  intensifying  the  measures  and doubling  the  efforts  on  battery  traceability  management  and  improving  the  recycling  standard system and supervision mechanism.

Power  battery  recycling  is  a  solution  to  both  environmental  pollution  and  strategic  resources shortage.  On  the  one  hand,  power  batteries  contain  a  large  number  of  heavy  metals  and  organic pollutants  such  as  nickel,  cobalt,  manganese,  copper,  phosphorus  and  electrolyte,  which,  if  not effectively recycled, will cause new energy to turn "black" from "green". Effective power battery recycling is the only way to maintain "green" commercialization of new energy. On the other hand, the large number of nickel, cobalt, lithium and manganese contained in power batteries are scarce resources, making power batteries an urban mine rich in nickel, cobalt, lithium and manganese. In 2022, the global output of cathode materials, anode materials, diaphragm and electrolyte, all being lithium electric materials, was about 1.85 million tons, 1.4 million tons, 13 billion square meters and 850,000 tons, respectively, all with YoY growth of more than 60%, and the gross output of the industry  exceeded  RMB1.2  trillion.  In  2025,  the  world's  lithium  battery  shipment  is  expected  to reach 2,211.8 GWh, and China's is expected to reach 1,250 GWh, accounting for about 50% of the world's total. On this basis, the global consumption of lithium, nickel and cobalt by the new energy vehicle  industry  will  reach  809,300  tons,  350,200  tons  and  210,000  tons,  respectively,  in  2025. Apparently,  with  the  rapid  development  of  new  energy  vehicles  and  the  extensive  utilization  of cobalt, nickel and lithium resources, the exploitation of cobalt, nickel and lithium resources will fail to  meet  the  increasing  demand  of  new  energy  commercialization  for them,  leading  to  a  growing shortage of cobalt, nickel and lithium resources worldwide. In 2022, against the rapid development of new energy, the nickel market is surging and the term "demon nickel" was created. On March 8, 2022, the world was shocked by the short squeeze in the nickel market in London, and nickel price

once hit USD100,000 per ton, a record high. Affected by it, the nickel ore market has been showing high trend, with the annual LME average price being USD25,638.37 per ton, a record high. The price of lithium has risen significantly in 2022, and has become an important strategic resource for the  global  NEV  industry.  By  December  2022,  the  average  market  price  of  battery-grade  lithium carbonate (of 99.5% purity) was about RMB520,000 per ton, up about 187% YoY, and the average market price of battery-grade lithium hydroxide (of 56.5% purity) was about RMB550,000 per ton, up 256% YoY. Lithium prices put enormous pressure on the development of new energy in 2022, which can no longer be sustained.

Thorough nickel, cobalt and lithium recycling and reuse of the urban mines of lithium, nickel and cobalt are the only ways for China's sustainable development of ternary new energy. In September 2022, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology made an official reply to the proposals on power battery recycling by issuing the Reply to Proposal No. 3775 to the 5th Session of the 13th National  People's  Congress (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  " Reply ").  The Reply notes  that  power battery  recycling  is  of  great  practical  significance  in  promoting  the  sustainable  and  healthy development of the new energy vehicle industry, protecting the ecological environment and social security, and ensuring the supply of strategic resources.

According to the statistics of USGS (The United States Geological Survey), China's cobalt reserves account  for  only  1.13%  of  the  world's  total,  its  nickel  reserves  account  for  only  3.0%,  and  its lithium reserves account for only 7.1%, while China's use of cobalt, lithium and nickel is more than 50% of the world's, and cobalt, lithium and nickel resources supply in China is seriously insecure. Therefore,  the  recycling  of  nickel,  cobalt  and  lithium  becomes  an  effective  way  to  resolve  the demand of China's new energy industry for the strategic cobalt, nickel and lithium resources.

According to the prediction of CITIC Securities, the power batteries of new energy vehicles will soon enter the peak period of scrapping, and the global battery recycling market space will exceed RMB150 billion in 2027. Further legislation on the power battery recycling industry will promote the  rapid  development  of  the  industry.  In  the  future,  battery  recycling  policies  will  be  gradually standardized  in  terms  of  environmental  protection  and  safety,  and  leading  enterprises  with advantages in channels, cascade utilization and resource-oriented technology will win out.

In 2018, China started whitelist-based management of power battery recycling enterprises meeting the Industry Standards and Conditions for Comprehensive Utilization of Waste Power Batteries of New Energy Vehicles , and has included a total of 88 enterprises in four batches in the white list up to date.

In 2022, more policies highlighted the further improvement of the power battery recycling system. In January 2022, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other seven ministries jointly issued the Implementation Plan for Accelerating the Comprehensive Utilization of Industrial Resources ,  which  proposes  to  improve  the  waste  power  battery  recycling  and  utilization  system, refine  management  policies,  and  enhance  the  whole-life-cycle  traceability  management  of  the power batteries of new energy vehicles, and encourages recycling channel co-building of upstream and  downstream  of  the  industrial  chain  and  co-construction  of  the  cross-region  recycling  and utilization system, as well as safe and cascade utilization of waste power batteries in the fields of backup  power  and  power  charging  and  exchange.  With  demonstration  projects  on  cascade utilization  and  regeneration  in  key  regions  including  the  Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei  Region,  Yangtze River Delta, and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, a number of elite enterprises on cascade utilization and regeneration have been fostered, and greater efforts have been devoted into the research and promotion of nondestructive testing, automatic disassembly and efficient valuable metal extraction of power batteries.

## (2) Scrap vehicle recycling business

The automobile industry is the pillar industry in China, and the total holdings of automobiles in China increase year by year. According to the Ministry of Public Security, the national holdings of motor  vehicles  in  China  reached  417  million  as  at  the  end  of  2022,  including  319  million automobiles,  up  5.39%  excluding  an  increase  of  21.29  million  scrap  and  deregistered  ones  from 2021. Meanwhile, the national holdings of automobiles reached 319 million, accounting for 76.59% of the total number of motor vehicles, an increase of 17.52 million, or 5.81%, from 2021. In 2022, 23.23  million  of  automobiles  were  newly  registered  nationwide,  and  the  net  increase  in  scrap automobiles was 5.71 million as estimated, showing stable growth.

Two new regulations, the Measures for Scrap Vehicle Recycling Management issued in 2019 and the Interim  Measures  for  Automobile  Part  Re-manufacturing  Management issued  in  2021,  have lifted the policy restrictions on the automobile disassembly industry from several aspects. On the one hand, they lift the restriction that the price of vehicle recycling shall refer to the market price of scrap  metal,  encouraging  owners  to  scrap  automobiles,  and  on  the  other  hand,  they  grant  more authorities  to  the  re-manufacturing  of  the  "five  major  assemblies",  allowing  enterprises  with recycling  qualifications  to  sell  the  assemblies  to  enterprises  capable  of  re-manufacturing  in accordance with relevant regulations, thus improving the profit margin of recycling enterprises. In accordance  with  the Implementation  Plan  for  Piloting  Extended  Producer  Responsibility  among Automobile  Product  Manufacturers released  in  2021,  the  Ministry  of  Industry  and  Information Technology  elected  qualified  automobile  product  manufacturers  for  piloting  Extended  Producer Responsibility  (EPR)  in  August  2022,  in  order  to  explore  the  formation  of  a  replicable  and promotable scrap vehicles recycling and reuse model with automobile manufacturers as the main responsible entities.

Vehicles scrapping will peak in 2025 in China, and the key trigger point will be the penetration rate of  new energy vehicles. With the rapid penetration of new energy vehicles, China will have 319 million fuel vehicles scrapped together by 2025, with the scrap rate exceeding 20%. From 2025 to 2030, the annual scrap rate will reach upwards of 15%.

## 2. Tungsten resources recycling business

Tungsten and rare earth are China's two major strategic resources affecting the world. The specific gravity of tungsten is 19.35 g/cm³ , nearly the same as that of gold (19.32 g/cm³ ), so it's commonly called "black gold". It is a globally scarce resource, and widely used for super-hard materials, CNC cutting  tools,  military  devices,  exothermic  and  luminescent  materials,  new  energy  materials  and other strategic purposes.

China has the largest reserve of tungsten resources (1.9 million tons, measured in metallic tungsten) in the world, and is the largest global supplier of tungsten resource products. Every year, more than 30,000 tons of tungsten resource products are exported from China, accounting for over 30% of the global consumption of tungsten resources.

China  implements  quota-based  exploitation  of  tungsten  resources.  The  total  mining  quota  of tungsten concentrate (tungsten trioxide content of 65%) in 2022 was 109,000 tons. With tungsten resource exploitation at the current speed, China's tungsten resource exploitation will enter the dry season 15 years later.

The  use  of  tungsten  resources  in  new  and  high-end  materials,  especially  in  new  energy  ternary materials  and  PV  silicon  wafer  cutting,  will  further  aggravate  the  global  shortage  of  tungsten resources.

In 2016, tungsten was included in the catalog of strategic minerals for the first time according to the National Mineral Resources Plan (2016-2020) . Improving the utilization rate of secondary tungsten resources in China is one of the effective ways to alleviate the excessive consumption of tungsten resources.

The 14th  Five-Year  Plan  for  the  Development  of  the  Raw  Material  Industry released  in  2021 proposes  to  tap  urban  mine  resources,  support  dominating  enterprises  to  build  large  bases  and industrial clusters for the recycling of waste steel and secondary aluminum, copper, lithium, nickel, cobalt,  tungsten  and  molybdenum,  and  promote  the  integrated  development  of  secondary  metal recycling, disassembly, processing, classification and distribution.

Full  recycling  of  tungsten  resources  in  China  is  a  practical  solution  to  the  global  shortage  of tungsten resources.

## 3. E-waste recycling and reuse business

According to the Global E-Waste Monitor released  by  the  UN,  the  world  produced  53.6  million tons of E-waste a year in 2019, up 21% from five years ago, and 74.7 million tons are expected in 2030. Of such a huge amount of E-waste, only 17.4% was properly treated, and refrigerant released from improperly treated air conditioners and refrigerators alone amounted to carbon emissions of 98 million  tons.  China  now  has  had  10.1  million  tons  of  E-waste,  being  the  world's  large  E-waste producer, with more than 200 million scrapped household appliances in need of treatment.

Standardized recycling and treatment of E-waste, a kind of special solid waste, has always been an issue of global concern. Currently, major countries in the world are solving E-waste problems with EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility). As an important environmental policy, EPR, in essence, is to extend the responsibility of manufacturers to the whole life cycle of their products, especially to  the  stage  of  recycling,  treatment  and  reuse  after  product  consumption.  In  the  field  of  E-waste treatment, EPR requires manufacturers to pay for the treatment of electronic and electrical products at the end of their service life. The EU promulgated the WEEE Directive and the RoHS Directive in 2003,  requiring  manufacturers  to  prohibit  the  use  of  six  types  of  harmful  chemicals  in  the production of electronic and electrical products, and also requiring them to recycle electronic and electrical products, at the end of their service life at the expense of themselves or their dealers. The directives cover 54 electronic and electrical products under five categories. In 2021, Japan enforced the  Household  Appliances  Recycling  Law,  requiring  consumers  to  pay  for  the  recycling  of  used household appliances. To date, the fee for disposing of a used household appliance in Japan ranges from JPY990 to 4,700.

China has enforced the Regulation on the Administration of the Recovery and Disposal of Waste Electrical  and  Electronic  Products since  January  1,  2011,  which  clearly  specifies  ERP  shall  be implemented for the manufacturers of TVs, washing machines, air conditioners, refrigerators and computers,  requiring  manufacturers  to  pay  for  the  disposal  of  scrap  household  appliances.  The relevant  ministries  and  commissions  have  established  national  norms  and  standards,  the  national supervision and inspection system and the disposal subsidy collection and allocation policy for the disposal  of  scrap  household  appliances,  and  have  included  109  designated  enterprises  for  scrap household appliance disposal in the list of grant of disposal subsidies. This disposal subsidy grant policy  is  the  practical  implementation  of  EPR  in  China,  as  EPR  has  been  extensively  applied  in major countries around the world.

It  has  effectively  promoted  the  standardized  management  of  E-waste  recycling  and  treatment  in China.  To  date,  over  85  million  TVs,  washing  machines,  air  conditioners,  refrigerators  and computers are properly treated every year in China, and China has become a fine example of  Ewaste management among developing countries around the world. The official enforcement of the

newly revised Law of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Control of Solid Waste Pollution on September 1, 2020, recognizes EPR as a definitive policy in legal form. In July 2021, the  National  Development  and  Reform  Commission  released  the "14th  Five-Year  Plan"  for Development of Circular Economy , which lists the "Action on Improving the Recycling Quality of Waste Electrical and Electronic Products" as one of the five key actions for the next five years. The Guidelines  on  Environmental  Management  and  Pollution  Prevention  for  Disposal  of  Nine Categories  of  Waste  Electrical  and  Electronic  Products ,  including  Range  Hoods  released  by  the Ministry  of  Ecology  and  Environment  in  September  2021  marks  the  countdown  to  standardized management of nine categories of E-waste, including range hoods. In December 2022, the Ministry of  Human Resources and Social Security issued the Outline of the Strategic Plan for Expanding Domestic  Demand  (2022-2035) ,  proposing  to  speed  up  the  construction  of  the  waste  material recycling  system  and  standardize  the  household  appliance  and  electronic  product  recycling industries.

E-waste recycling reduces pollution on the one hand, reduces carbon emissions on the other hand, and is an effective way to reduce carbon emissions significantly. Supported by favorable policies, such as "carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality" and "winning the battle against pollution", the E-waste treatment industry is facing brighter prospects.

## iii. Environmental management business

In 2022, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment issued the Guide to Including Financial Support Projects  for  Ecological  and  Environmental  Protection  in  the  Reserve  Pool  (Trial) and  the Implementation  Plan  for  Improving  Synergistic  Efficiency  of  Pollution  Reduction  and  Carbon Emission  Reduction to  show  its  key  support  for  air  pollution,  water  pollution  and  soil  pollution projects under eight categories, in order to promote further practice of EOD and top-level design and system building in the field of new pollutant treatment, speed up the implementation of major ecological  and  environmental  projects  during  the  14th  Five-Year  Plan  period,  actively  increase effective investment in ecological and environmental management, increase green assets, and gain benefits from environmental, climate and economic sectors.

The Central Inspection of Ecological and Environmental Protection (CIEEP) was planned, deployed and promoted by General Secretary Xi Jinping in person is a key original achievement of and policy guarantee for Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization. The sixth CIEEP of the second round was completed in June 2022, marking the successful completion of this round of CIEEP started in July 2019. Meanwhile, a systematic plan is being developed for the third round of CIEEP, in order to  effectively  urge  the  relevant  functional  authorities  to  fulfill  their  responsibilities  for  ecological and environmental protection and form joint efforts.

As China keeps devoting greater efforts to environmental protection and improving the policies for the environmental protection industry, the industry will maintain rapid development and continuous expansion.  According  to  the Report  on  In-depth  Market  Survey  and  Investment  and  Financing Strategy  Consulting  for  China's  Water  Environment  Governance  Industry  (2023-2028) ,  China's environmental protection industry is expected to see a market size of RMB4,682.02 billion in 2025, with a compound annual growth rate of 19.4%, and the market will scale up further, and by 2025, the  market  size  of  China's  sewage  treatment  industry  is  expected  to  reach  RMB2,448.67  billion, with a compound annual growth rate of 18.0%, and the apparent demand for hazardous  waste is expected to reach 130 million tons, with the supply of hazardous waste treatment falling short of demand.

## II Business Scope in the Reporting Period

## i. Overview of the principal business

The  Company's  principal  business  is  new  energy  materials  manufacturing  and  urban  mining, forming an industrial system driven by dual tracks of "new energy materials manufacturing + urban mining". In 2022, the sales scale of the Company's new energy material  business (mainly power materials of ternary precursors and 3C digital materials of tricobalt tetraoxide) accounted for 74.16% of the total sales scale, while the sales scale of the urban mining business (scrap power batteries and scrap vehicles), E-waste recycling, and tungsten resources recycling accounted for 25.84% of the total sales scale. In 2022, the Company recorded operating revenue of RMB21,797 million for the new energy material business, up 58.76% year on year; and the operating revenue of the Company's urban mining business reached RMB7,595 million, up 36.32% year on year.

The  Company  was  listed  in  the  2021  Forbes  China  Top  50  Most  Innovative Companies and was selected as one of the "50 Smartest Companies" (TR50) in 2021 by the MIT Technology Review, an international authoritative technology and business media.

Conducted recycling business all over China and play an important role in the regeneration scale of waste. The Company established 19 green recycling industrial parks, covering 11 provinces and  municipalities  directly  under  the  Central  Government  including  Hubei,  Hunan,  Guangdong, Jiangxi, Henan, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, and Fujian as well as Indonesia, South Korea, South Africa, and other countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, bringing green technologies to all the world. In 2022, the Company recycled and processed a total of more than 10 million tons of waste and recycled and regenerated over 30 scarce resources such as cobalt, nickel, lithium, copper, tungsten, gold, silver, platinum, palladium, rhodium, gallium, germanium, and rare earth  and  multiple  high-tech  products  such  as  ultra-fine  powder  material,  power  battery  raw materials,  and  power  battery  materials,  with  a  total  of  more  than  half  million  tons  of  remanufactured products annually. Specifically, the E-waste, retired power batteries (except for leadacid batteries), and scrap vehicles recycled and processed by the Company accounted for 10%, 10%, and  5%  of  China's  total  waste,  respectively.  In  addition,  the  recycled  and  regenerated  cobalt resources were more than 3.0 times China's original cobalt mining. The recycled and regenerated

nickel and tungsten resources accounted for over 13% and 6% of China's original nickel mining and tungsten mining, respectively.

Deeply participated in global industrial chain cooperation and became an indispensable core enterprise of the global supply chain. The Company has served global renown customer groups and quality customers of the strategic emerging industry such as SAMSUNG SDI, CATL, SK On, ECOPRO,  LGC,  ATL,  Umicore, Sandvik, Kennametal, BYD,  China Minmetals, Ronbay Technology, and Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd. (XTC). The Company ranked second in the world in terms  of  the  shipment  of  ternary  precursors  for  power  batteries  (the  shipment  of  8-series  and  9series ultra-high nickel ternary precursors ranked first in the global market), accounting for more than 15% of the global market. It equipped 15% of the world's new energy vehicles with ternary batteries,  better  serving  the  "green  to  green"  of  the  world's  new  energy  vehicles;  in  addition,  the shipment of the tricobalt tetraoxide used for 3C digital batteries ranked among the top three in the global market, accounting for more than 20% of the global market. The ultra-fine cobalt powder ranked first in the world's industrial market, accounting for more than 50% of the world's hard alloy market. Furthermore, more than 60% of the world's hard alloy factories use ultra-fine cobalt powder recycled and re-manufactured by the Company.

Green facilitated world economic recovery and ESG value made the world shine. In 2022, the Company  focused  on  the  difficult  waste  treatment  problems  of  global  concern  such  as  power batteries,  E-waste,  and  waste  plastics  and  addressed  the  difficulties  in  processing  the  waste  by creating new technologies, investing more funds, and expanding scales, achieving commercialized and economic success.

In  2022,  with  the  idea  of  technology,  intelligence  and  green,  the  Company  constructed  the "Technology  +  Intelligence  +  Green"  high-tech  industrial  park  for  new  energy  raw  materials  of nickel resources and put it into operation, recruiting more than 2,000 local employees and becoming one  of  the  highlight  projects  of  China-Indonesia  cooperation.  The  Company  issued  GDR  and sustainable  development  credit  on  the  SIX  Swiss  Exchange  and  the  global  interbank  market  to provide  investment  opportunities  for  global  investors,  completing  the  global  layout  of  green development.

The  Company  established  a  new  energy  industrial  chain  mode  of  "Indonesian  nickel  resource  material  and  battery  manufacturing  in  South  Korea  -  facing  global  market"  as  well  as  the  new energy' full life-cycle value chain mode of "power battery recycling nickel - battery reuse - material re-manufacturing  -  battery  re-manufacturing"  with  upstream  and  downstream  enterprises  in  the world such as SK ON, ECOPRO, Mercedes-Benz China, and CATL.

The Company cooperated with the British Standards Institute (BSI) to carry out carbon footprint verification  of  all  parks  of  the  Group  and  comprehensively  promoted  standard  measurement  of carbon emission and reduction of various business types. The Company's urban mining business reduced  carbon  of  the  supply  chain  by  more  than  880,000  tons,  up  129.28%  year  on  year, contributing positively to the supply chain carbon reduction of the automobile industry.

The  Company  actively  promoted  the  pilot  construction  of  zero-carbon  parks.  The  created  zerocarbon demonstration park - Wuhan Power Battery Regeneration Technology Co., Ltd. received the carbon  neutral  certificate  in  2022  issued  by  SGS-CSTC  Standards  Technical  Services  Co., Ltd.(SGS),  an  internationally  renowned  certification  institution.  The  park  has  realized  carbon neutrality,  making  a  contribution  to  building  a  recycling  society  and  curbing  the  greenhouse  gas effect  as  a  Chinese  enterprise,  and  becoming  a  representative  of  global  advanced  enterprises  in practicing green and low-carbon development.

## ii. Analysis of operating results

## 1. The capacity was fully released and the operating results grew at a high speed against the trend

In  2022,  the  Company's  operating  results  recorded  a  historic  high  against  the  trend.  The  sales volume achieved the objective of "exceeding RMB26 billion and striving for RMB28 billion" as scheduled. The Company realized a revenue of RMB29,392 million, up 52.28% year on year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company of RMB1,296 million, up 40.36% year on year. All of them registered a record high. The Company strode to the new development stage of "releasing capacity and boosting operating results".

Sales Revenue and Net Profits in 2020-2022

<!-- image -->

## (1) The new energy business led the growth and the Company consolidated its core position in the global industry in all respects

In 2022, the Company's business of new energy battery materials received an operating revenue of RMB21,797 million, up 58.76% year on year.

In 2022, the annual shipment of ternary precursor materials for power batteries, the Company's core product,  reached  152,280  tons,  a  significant  increase  of  67.28%  year  on  year,  registering  an operating  revenue  of  RMB16,147  million,  up  71.33%  year  on  year,  with  the  shipment  steadily ranking among the top 2 in the global market. The export of ternary precursor materials reached 85,383 tons, up approximately 150% year on year, accounting for 56.07% of total shipments. The shipment of 8-series and above high-nickel products amounted to 114,615 tons, accounting for over 75%  of  the  total  shipments,  and  the  shipment  of  9-series  ultra-high  nickel  (Ni90  and  above) products amounted to 91,455 tons, accounting for 60% of the total shipments. The latest generation of core-shell precursors with gradient and high-voltage ternary precursors were sold at 5,250 tons and 5,274 tons, respectively. The ternary precursors have been shifted to the upgrade of 8-series and above high-nickel products and high-tech manufacturing dominated by 9-series of ultra-high nickel, leading  the  industry  in  terms  of  the  global  new  generation  high-nickel  precursor  manufacturing technology and commercialization speed. The Company grasped the opportunity to develop sodium electric  materials.  Products  from  the  trial  runs  of  ton-level  production  lines  comprehensively entered the stage of approval by the mainstream market and customers. The Company has risen to the front position in terms of sodium electric materials.

As  of  the  end  of  2022,  the  Company's  total  production  capacity  of  ternary  precursors  in  China reached 260,000 tons/year.

<!-- image -->

In  2022,  the  Company  sold  more  than  14,800  tons  of  tricobalt  tetraoxide,  reaching  an  operating revenue of RMB4,004 million, up 35.63% year on year, accounting for approximately 20% of the supply of tricobalt tetraoxide globally, ranking among the top three in the world.

In  2022, the sales volume of the Company's cathode materials reached 8,450 tons, registering an operating revenue of RMB1,647 million, up 21.65% year on year. The high-nickel market made breakthroughs.  The  PPES  power battery  project  of  Panasonic  made  substantive  progress  and  the demonstration line of lithium iron phosphate was put into operation.

In  2022, the Company's nickel-cobalt-manganese raw material system totaled more than 160,000 tons  of  amount  of  metal,  up  40%  year  on  year.  Specifically,  the  raw  material  system  of  nickel reached more than 100,000 tons and the lithium recycling capacity was expanded. The recycling capacity of lithium carbonates reached 500 tons/month.

In  2022,  the  nickel  resources  recovered  and  used  by  the  Company  reached  over  15,000  tons, accounting for more than 13% of China's production capacity of primary nickel. In 2022, the cobalt resources recovered and used by the Company reached over 7,500 tons, accounting for more than 340% of China's production capacity of primary cobalt.

## (2) The urban mining business optimized and upgraded, and power battery recycling became a new growth pole

In 2022, the Company's urban mining business achieved a revenue of RMB7,595 million, up 36.32% year on year.

In 2022, the Company's power battery recycling business and cascade utilization business achieved a revenue of RMB622 million, with a significant increase of 312.60% year on year. The recycled and  dismantled  power  batteries  reached  17,432.73  tons  (2.10  GWh),  up  98.11%  year  on  year, accounting for more than 10% of China's total waste of power batteries and the Company's power battery cascade utilization products entered the large-scale market-oriented and commercialization stage. The Company successively established a directional circulation mode from green scrap end to green product end with Sunward Intelligent, REPT BATTERO Energy, VOYAH, Mercedes-Benz China,  and  CATL,  building  a  new  energy'  full  life-cycle  value  chain  mode  of  "power  battery recycling  nickel  -  battery  reuse  -  material  re-manufacturing  -  battery  re-manufacturing".  They worked  together  to  establish  a  battery  passport,  achieving  sustainable  development  and  better serving the commercialization need of "from green to green" of China and the world's new energy.

In  2022,  Green  Recycling  rapidly  achieved  a  three-track  drive  of  "recovery  and  disassembly  of waste and old home appliances + comprehensive utilization of waste circuit board", registering a revenue  of  RMB2,131  million  in  2022,  up  23.85%  year  on  year.  Specifically,  scrap  appliances dismantled  in  a  standardized  manner  amounted  to  8.42  million  units/sets,  ranking  second  in  the industry and accounting for 10% of China's total waste; the recycled plastics and products reached more than 60,000 tons, up approximately 30% year on year, ranking first in the E-waste industry; and recycling amount of precious metals reached 1.2 tons. Green Recycling has rapidly transformed from the primary mode of resource-based utilization dominated by the recovery and disassembly of scrap  appliances  to  the  in-depth  recycling  and  re-manufacturing  mode  of  "recycling  +  remanufacturing". It set up a new re-production line for waste plastics, opening up an industrial mode of  "waste  plastics  -  modified  recycling  -  re-manufacturing"  and  introducing  recycled  products  of waste plastics to the global supply chain system. In addition, such products have been demonstrated by end-brand customers such as Panasonic, Midea, and Haier, driving recycled products of waste plastics to enter high-end supply chains in all respects. The Company has revealed a market mode of re-utilization of tremendous waste plastics in the world, further increasing low-carbon and green value.

## 4.  The  Company  wrote  a  new  chapter  in  the  international  market  and  consolidated  the cooperation of the global industrial chain

In 2022, the Company precisely judged the changes in the competition pattern of the global industry as well as challenges brought by the trade protectionism set by the United States. With a forwardlooking  mindset, a decisive  move,  and  combined  strength,  it  managed  to  consolidate  the cooperation of the global industrial chain to cope with market challenges. In the competition of the global market, it adopted several measures at the same time and successfully safeguarded its core position in the global market and supply chain.

(1) The Company successively signed with ECOPRO, XTC New Energy, and other domestic and overseas  renowned  enterprises  for  million-ton  ternary  precursor  orders  and  established  solid partnerships  with  core  customers,  consolidating  its  global  core  position  in  terms  of  ternary precursors;

(2) The Company coped with the IRA Act of the United States and the CRMA Act of the EU and worked  together  with  South  Korean  enterprises  to  provide  a  solution  mode  to  open  up  market channels to the United States and the European markets;

The Company signed a Memorandum with SK On and ECOPRO to construct 30,000 tons of nickel resources  for  the  HPAL  Joint  Venture  Corporation  on  Big  K  Island,  Indonesia.  It  also  signed  a Memorandum with SK On and ECOPRO MATERIALS to invest and construct a manufacturing factory for the new generation of ultra-high nickel precursors for secondary power batteries with a production capacity of 43,000 tons and above/year and the supporting system for the raw materials of  nickel-cobalt-manganese  in  the  Saemangeum National Industrial Complex  to  build  the  supply chain mode for key battery raw materials and materials of the "development of nickel resources raw  material  and  material  manufacturing  -  battery  manufacturing  -  facing  global  market".  The breakout of the IRA Act imposed by the United States and the CRMA Act enacted by the EU has been  an  effective  strategic  measure  to  stabilize  South  Korea's  core  market  and  orient  to  the  US market  and  the  EU  market  and  an  effective  approach  to  safeguarding  the  rights  and  interests  of Chinese  enterprises in the global market, proving  a  Chinese  mode  for  the  world's  green development.

(3)  The  Company  signed  a  strategic  cooperation  agreement  with  Tsingshan  and  Weiming  to construct an Industrial Park for New Energy Material Nickel Resources in Wenzhou together so that the three parties can implement in-depth cooperation in the whole industry chain in terms of nickel resources,  raw  material  system  manufacturing,  and  power  batteries  recycling.  They  formed  a strategic  partnership  with  each  other  and  participated  in  the  construction  of  the  industry  chain system  from  "nickel  resource  -  raw  material  manufacturing  -  material  manufacturing  -  battery recovery" to jointly promote the improvement of the industry chain and their core competitiveness;

(4) The Company opened up the platform for the dominant business equity to achieve symbiosis with upstream and downstream enterprises. In 2022, the Company completed the reform toward a mixed  system  for  the  socialization  equity  for  Power  Regeneration  (the  Company's  subordinate company)  and  green  tungsten  resources,  introducing  more  than  RMB1.1  billion  of  capital.  It promoted from green to green to construct a recycled industry chain through cooperation with social capital.

In 2022, the Company invested RMB392 million in the upstream and downstream industry chain. It successively  invested  in  the  upstream  and  downstream  and  ESG  projects  such  as  the  ternary positive electrode of Libode, ferric phosphate material of Yonfer, membrane technology of ENTEK, environmental protection equipment of SUNEVAP, and biology of Neowioe, achieving symbiosis with upstream and downstream enterprises.

(5)  The  Company  worked  together  with  Benz  and  other  global  quality  enterprises  to  build  a directional  circulation  mode  from  green  scrap  end  to  green  product  end,  driving  global  green development and recovery.

In  2022,  Power  Regeneration  successively  signed  strategic  cooperation  agreements  for  the  green recycling of power batteries with Sunward Intelligent, REPT BATTERO Energy, and VOYAH to jointly build the full life-cycle value chain system for the used power batteries and the recycling of its waste, resource base, and re-manufacturing, forming a green industry chain from the complete green recycling of power batteries and their wastes, re-manufacturing of nickel, cobalt, and lithium,

re-manufacturing of ternary materials, and gradient utilization of power batteries to achieve from green scrap end to green product end, exploring the paradigm of the green development of global new  energy  industry.  In  February  2023,  the  Company  signed  memorandums  of  understanding (MOU) with Mercedes-Benz China, CATL, and Brunp to build the closed-loop recycling project of batteries. After Mercedes-Benz China handed over its decommissioned power batteries to GEM and Brunp  for  processing,  the  regenerated  key  raw  materials  such  as  nickel,  cobalt,  manganese,  and lithium by their advanced recycling technologies will be re-supplied to the supply chain of CATL to produce new batteries for Mercedes-Benz China. Meanwhile, all parties will carry out extensive and in-depth  exploration  and  cooperation  in  terms  of  battery  recycling  technologies  and  recycling business mode so as to jointly create a competitive green supply chain and value chain in the world and promote global green development and recovery.

## 5. Innovation boosted fruitful achievements and key technologies led the industry

2022 was the first year for GEM's innovation multiplication plan and digital upgrade. ## 2) The core technological barriers of many latest generation of products were overcome, with eight standard new technological achievements occupying the technological highland

Landmark technical achievement 1: The high-pressure leaching green manufacturing line of the Indonesian QMB Nickel Resource Project was opened, becoming the world's first production line for hydrometallurgy of low-grade laterite nickel ore that was designed and constructed independently. The investment per 10,000-ton unit was reduced to below USD180 million, with a nickel  recovery  amount  of  over  95%,  which  is  the  successful  presentation  of  technologies  and equipment of Chinese enterprises in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative.

Landmark technical achievement 2: The latest generation of core-shell ternary precursors with concentration gradient ultra-high nickel and low cobalt (8-series) realized large-scale commercialization.  On  May  30,  2022,  the  first  mass  manufacturing  of  the  Company's  latest generation  of  core-shell  ternary  precursors  with  concentration  gradient  ultra-high  nickel  and  low cobalt was delivered, marking the Company's start of the large-scale manufacturing of such coreshell ternary precursors. The Company has become one of the few enterprises in the world to realize large-scale  manufacturing  of  such  core-shell  ternary  precursors,  signifying  that  the  Company's production technique and equipment for ternary precursors have truly entered the "leading zone" of the industry.

Landmark technical achievement 3: A breakthrough in high-voltage nickel precursor technology was  made  and  the  mass  manufacturing  and  supply  were  realized,  further  diversifying  the Company's high-end precursor production line.

Landmark  technical  achievement  4: The  pilot  test  on  the  development  project  on  the  mass manufacturing of bimetallic-doped quinary precursor was completed, entering the mass manufacturing development stage. The Company has seized opportunities in the next generation of the multi-metal-doped precursor market.

Landmark technical achievement 5: The research of sodium-electric material technology made rapid progress and industrialization would be possible. The Company made breakthroughs in such technical difficulties as the iron-manganese anti-oxidation and crystal uniformity of the nickel-ironmanganese-sodium  electric  precursor  and  the  material  technology  of  sodium-ion  battery  cathode

with  a  layered  oxide  structure  passed  the  pilot  test,  rapidly  promoting  mass  manufacturing development.

Landmark  technical  achievement 6: Breakthroughs in the new  generation cobalt oxide technologies  were  made,  such  as  quaternary  doped  cobalt  oxide,  high-capacity  and  high-cycle cobalt oxide, and high-rate ammonia-free hydroxyl system aluminum-doped cobalt oxide, marking the Company entered the mass manufacturing stage.

Landmark technical achievement 7: The breakthroughs in high-value recycling and utilization of waste  lithium-iron  phosphate  scrap,  the  recovery  of  waste  negative  electrode  graphite  and  its utilization according to a different quality, the rapid separation of retired power battery for cascade utilization,  aging  mechanism  and  life  prediction  technology  and  other  series  of  retired  power batteries  and  retired  battery  materials  were  made,  comprehensively  consolidating  the  Company's core competitiveness in the field of retired power batteries and battery waste recycling.

Landmark technical achievement 8: A breakthrough was made in the key innovation technology of  simultaneous  recycling  of  nickel  and  iron  in  ferronickel  alloy  into  new  energy  raw  materials, establishing  the  process  route  of  direct  manufacturing  of  iron  phosphate  and  nickel  sulfate  with ferronickel.  The  project  on  manufacturing  iron  phosphate  and  battery-grade  nickel  sulfate  with 10,000 tons of ferronickel jointly invested by the Company and Tsingshan Holding was completed. The lithium-iron phosphate manufacturing line with an annual output of 20,000 tons was built in Fuan Qingmei.

## 6.  The  Company  precisely  predicted  the  situation,  adjusted  the  structure  of  raw  materials, and successfully mitigated raw material risk

In 2022, the nickel market was surging and the term "demon nickel" was created. On March 8, 2022, the  world  was  shocked  by  the  short  squeeze  in  the  nickel  market  in  London.  As  the  biggest consumer of nickel in the industry, GEM became a few of the enterprises that were not subject to material  losses  for  not  participating  in  the  short  sale  of  nickel  futures,  circumventing  the unprecedented risk in a century. It benefited from GEM's long-term robust operation strategy for not  gambling.  After  the  occurrence  of  the  short  squeeze  in  the  nickel  market  in  London,  the Company decisively adjusted the structure of raw materials, altered procurement strategies, released the advantages at the raw material end, and successfully mitigated the raw material risk of "demon nickel".

At present, the number of R&amp;D  personnel  is  more  than  1,560,  which  shows  that  the  Company  is  vigorously  promoting innovation and has become a competitive enterprise that dares to invest in innovation in the industry.
