## 4. Achieve breakthrough advantages in core technologies

During the Reporting Period, the Company focused on the cutting-edge, core technologies of the industry  chain,  and  achieved  core  technological  breakthroughs  in  multiple  fields,  including  the recycling  and  cascade  utilization  of  power  batteries,  the  new-generation  new  energy  materials technologies, low-grade laterite nickel ore hydrometallurgy, and the recycling of tungsten and  Ewaste. By doing so, it achieved a range of core technologies, promoted the mass production of a batch of new-generation materials, and comprehensively enhanced its core technological competitiveness in "manufacturing of new energy materials and urban mining".

In  terms  of  the  intelligent  disassembling  and  recycling  of  waste  power  batteries,  the  Company constantly optimized the system for flexible and intelligent disassembling of retired power battery packs  and  achieved  functions  such  as  intelligent  identification,  automated  planning  of  robot trajectories, and  flexible control of end  disassembling. Additionally, with the ultra-precise directional extraction technology and the endogenous aluminum fluorine absorption and purification  technology,  the  Company  achieved  the  battery-level  raw  materials  recycling  of  full metallic components of waste ternary ion batteries, which addressed the difficulty of low lithium recycling rate in traditional process and enabled the lithium recycling rate to surpass 90%. Power Regeneration  (Wuhan),  Power  Regeneration  (Wuxi),  and  Power  Regeneration  (Tianjin)  were regarded  as  model  enterprises  in  the  comprehensive  utilization  of  waste  power  batteries  for  new energy vehicles. Moreover, Power Regeneration (Wuhan) was rewarded with "Excellent Scenario of

China's Intelligent  Manufacturing for 2022".  In terms of the research of  the new-generation new energy  materials  product,  based  on  the  atom-level  innovation  concept,  the  Company  developed multiple cutting-edge, innovative technologies, such as the molecular "processing" design technology, crystal plane control technology, liquid nano assembly technology, and in-situ doping. Besides,  it  achieved  core  technological  breakthroughs  and  solved  equipment  problems  in  the preparation of the new-generation high-end precursor products, such as sodium-ion battery layered oxide materials,  lithium-rich  manganese-based materials, ultra-high nickel ternary materials,  fullconcentration core-shell structure materials, cobalt-free materials, and NCMA/NCMW quaternary materials,  and  achieved  the  mass  production  of  Series  8  high  nickel  core-shell-concentration gradient  structure  ternary  precursors,  quaternary  precursors  and  high-voltage  medium-nickel products.  On  May  30,  2022,  the  first  mass  manufacturing  of  the  Company's  latest  generation  of core-shell  ternary  precursors  with  concentration  gradient  ultra-high  nickel  and  low  cobalt  was delivered, marking the Company's start of the large-scale manufacturing of such core-shell ternary precursors. The  Company  has  become  the  only  enterprise  in  China  to  realize large-scale manufacturing  of  such  core-shell  ternary  precursors,  signifying  that  the  Company's  production technique and equipment for ternary precursors have truly entered the "leading zone" of the industry. On  September  8,  2022,  the  first  mass  manufacturing  of  the  Company's  high-voltage  quaternary precursors  was  delivered,  marking  the  Company's  start  of  the  large-scale  manufacturing  and marketization  of  such  core-shell  ternary  precursors.  The  Company  has  become  one  of  the  few enterprises  in  the  world  to  realize  large-scale  manufacturing  of  new-generation  high-voltage quaternary precursor materials.

In terms of the recycling of nickel, cobalt and tungsten resources, the Company developed a number of new technologies such as the high- and low-temperature catalytic activation "native" technology and  the  crystal  lattice  repair  technology.  With  them,  the  Company  achieved  the  "performance repair"  and  material  remanufacturing  of  the  ineffective  nickel,  cobalt  and  tungsten  elements, prepared  ultra-fine  cobalt  powder  and  high-performance  tungsten  carbide  numerical  control materials, and systematically solved the technological difficulties in the recycling of nickel, cobalt and tungsten resources and high-quality products.

In  terms  of  the  resource-based  utilization  of  E-waste,  the  Company  developed  a  high-value technology  system  for  waste  plastics,  with  in-depth  cleaning  and  sorting  and  performance modification formula as the focus. The performance of the regenerated plastics with performance modified came up to that of the raw materials, which eliminated the bottleneck in the field of simple recycling of E-waste plastics.

## ii. Advantages in the recycling industry chain

## 1. The green and low-carbon recycling industry layout that is based in China and expanded into the global market

The Company has laid out its recycling industry mainly in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Metropolitan Region,  the  Yangtze  Delta,  Central  China,  the  Pearl  River  Delta,  and  other  cities  with  advanced industries,  transportation  and  logistics,  concentrated  populations,  and  regional  advantages.  These regions  contribute  more  than  65%  of  the  country's  GDP  and  represent  more  than  60%  of  the country's new energy vehicles. Accordingly, they can generate hundreds of millions of tons of scrap cars,  E-waste,  retired  batteries,  and  industrial  waste  per  year.  So  far,  the  Company  has  built  16 recycling industrial parks in 11 provinces and municipalities, including Jiangsu, Guangdong, Hubei, Jiangxi,  Hunan,  Henan,  Tianjin,  Shanxi,  Fujian,  and  Inner  Mongolia,  and  formed  a  recycling industry layout composed of a south-north axis of 3,000 kilometers and an east-west axis of 3,000 kilometers. Additionally, it has created a huge urban mining system with Chinese core cities as the focus,  covering  an  urban  mining  demonstration  model  integrating  multiple  layers  of  "recycling

boxes-recycling  supermarkets-large  distribution  markets-low-carbon  recycling  plants-urban mining industrial parks" and a manufacturing system of new energy materials.

By cooperating with partners, GEM has successfully laid out its business in South Africa, South Korea, and Indonesia around strategic resources and new energy material industry clusters to spread over the world.

The Company will plan to invest in Europe, lay out power battery recycling, serve for the greening of new energy and the security of strategic resources of nickel, cobalt and lithium in Europe, create a global recycling factory, and radiate green technologies to the world.

## 2.  Introduce  waste  recycling,  remanufacturing,  and  deep  processing  to  the  new  material industrial chain

The Company has made a breakthrough in solving China's key technical and equipment difficulties in  the  green  treatment  and  recycling  of  typical  waste  resources,  such  as  waste  batteries,  lithium, cobalt, nickel, and tungsten waste, E-waste, and scrapped automobiles, developed key technologies and  products, such  as high-nickel ternary precursors, ultrafine cobalt  powder,  high-quality remanufactured  tungsten,  high-quality  PCR  plastics,  extraction  of  rare  and  precious  metals,  and intelligent manufacturing of power battery packs, and formed an independent core technology and intellectual property system. Furthermore, it has built resource recycling and new energy material manufacturing models, such as the new energy lifecycle value chain, the tungsten recycling value chain, and the E-waste recycling and recovery value chain, and set a benchmark for high-quality development in the green and low-carbon recycling industry.

In  the  recycling  industry  chain  of  new  energy  materials  and  waste  batteries,  the  Company  has established an urban mining system for the key mineral resources of lithium, nickel, and cobalt. The Company  has  overcome  the  technical  difficulties  for  the  efficient  and  green  whole-process recycling of low-grade refractory cobalt, nickel, and lithium waste, developed the key technologies for the whole industry chain from lithium, nickel, and cobalt raw materials to new energy materials, and  established  the  world's  most  comprehensive  lithium-ion  battery  raw  material  and  material manufacturing  system  and  an  urban  mining  system  for  lithium,  nickel,  and  cobalt  nationwide, thereby  providing  strategic  support  for  the  key  mineral  resources  of  lithium,  nickel,  and  cobalt required by China's new energy industry. In terms of power battery recycling, the Company aims at the  global  market,  and  develops  the  business  in  accordance  with  the  global  strategic  goals  of "leading  China,  leading  the  world"  and  "50%  cooperation,  30%  recycling".  It  has  successfully joined hands with more than 670 car manufacturers, battery manufacturers, and bus and taxi service providers around the world, including Toyota, Volkswagen, SAMSUNG, Ronbay, EVE Energy, and Farasis Energy, to actively build a national recycling network of "ditches, streams, rivers, and seas". It  has  established five regional recycling and processing centers for waste power battery packs in Wuhan, Jingmen, Wuxi, Tianjin, and the Shenzhen-Shantou Special Cooperation Zone, realizing the full  lifecycle value chain model of "green manufacturing to manufacturing green" in the industry chain of new energy vehicles.

In terms of tungsten recycling, the Company has made precise efforts to innovate and upgrade the core business of tungsten recycling and high-end tungsten product remanufacturing, and continued to  consolidate  the  tungsten  resources  of  "tungsten  resources  recycling  -  resource  regenerationmaterial remanufacturing-product remanufacturing-product reuse" The recycling value chain has established  a  tungsten  resource  directional  recycling  system  with  the  world's  leading  enterprises such as Foxconn, PLANSEE, and IMC Group, focusing on the development of high-performance tungsten carbide and tungsten powder materials, which has greatly improved the profitability and global competitiveness of the core tungsten business.

In terms of the recycling and utilization of E-waste, the Company demerged and established Jiangxi Green  Recycling  Industry  Co.,  Ltd.,  and  developed  key  core  technologies  such  as  efficient dismantling of E-waste, automated crushing and sorting of E-waste, cleaning and sorting of waste plastics  and  pollution  treatment,  preparation  of  modified  recycled  plastics  from  waste  plastics, pyrolysis and clean disposal of circuit boards, and green directional separation of rare and precious metals, making GEM the world's leading comprehensive treatment manufacturer of E-waste. Green Recycling actively cooperated with the electronics manufacturing giant to implement the "Recycling Target Responsibility System" for producers and establish a recycling industry chain. The high-quality PCR recycled plastics produced by the Company have comprehensively entered the automotive, home appliance, daily chemical and toy markets.

## iii. Advantages of raw material security for the cobalt and nickel strategy

Compared  to  its  industry  peers,  one  of  GEM's  core  strengths  is  its  "recycling  system  +  wet chemistry  system  +  environmental  management  system",  with  four  core  chemical  manufacturing bases  in  Jingmen,  Hubei,  Taixing,  Jiangsu,  Fu'an,  Fujian  and  Indonesia.  In  the  field  of  ternary precursors and tricobalt tetraoxide products, the Company has 20 years of wet chemical technology experience and has established a complete "chemical raw material system + precursor manufacturing system", with a full industrial chain from waste recycling to material remanufacturing, opening up the path of waste recycling and consolidating its core position in the field of global waste recycling.

Together  with  Tsingshan  Holding  Group  Company  Limited  (Tsingshan),  Zhejiang  Weiming Environment Protection Co., Ltd. (Weiming Environment), and Shenzhen Capchem Technology Co., Ltd. (Capchem), the Company has entered into an agreement on the construction of the "Wenzhou New Energy Battery Materials Industrial Park" with the Wenzhou Municipal People's Government. A green chemical industrial park will be built on Xiaomen Island, Damen Town, Dongtou District, Wenzhou  City,  to  achieve  the  annual  h  capacities  of  500,000  tons  of  nickel-cobalt-manganese sulfate  crystal  materials  and  10,000  tons  of  high-purity  lithium  carbonates.  It  will  become  the Company's  second  chemical  industrial  base  near  the  sea,  meeting  GEM's  need  to  develop  a chemical system. The Company has a unique and sustainable profit model compared with other new energy material manufacturers and resource recycling enterprises. The Company's ternary precursor products occupy the two core processes of chemical raw material system and material synthesis, and the average gross profit margin is higher than the industry average, which is a great advantage for the Company.

With  the  rapid  development  of  ternary  power  batteries  towards  high  nickel  and  low  cobalt, mastering  nickel  resources  is  crucial  to  future  strategic  competition  in  ternary  materials.  The Company actively implemented the multi-material strategic channel of "urban mining + self-built nickel resource bases + strategic cooperation with  international giants" for cobalt and nickel raw materials to build a cobalt and nickel raw material system with international competitiveness and fully guarantee the security of the raw material supply system.

GEM conducted  strategic  cooperation  with  international  giants.  The  Company  consolidated  and expanded  its  long-term  strategic  cooperation  with  foreign  mineral  giants  and  signed  long-term orders with international mining and metallurgical giants such as Glencore and Legions to lock in strategic raw material supply, further enhancing the Company's supply security capability and core competitiveness in the field of global raw material manufacturing for ternary batteries.

On September 26, 2022, the launch ceremony of the first phase of the Company's Indonesian QMB Nickel Resource Project (30,000 tons of nickel/year), designed with the idea of "technology, green, and intelligence", was held at the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP) on K Island, Sulawesi

Tengah, Indonesia. The industrial park was put into production to enter a new phase. On January 14, 2023, the first batch of quality nickel-cobalt-manganese MHP of 1,200 tons of metallic nickel was loaded for delivery. MHP of 4,500 tons of metallic nickel was produced in the first quarter of 2023. MHP of more than 26,000 tons of metallic nickel is expected to be produced throughout the year. The year 2023 will witness the achievement of the capacity of 30,000 tons of metallic nickel/year of the first phase of the Indonesian QMB Nickel Resource Project. The second phase with a capacity of 43,000 tons of metallic nickel/year is now under rapid construction so as to strongly support the rapid progress of GEM's new energy material industry, create mutual and in-depth cooperation of the  nickel  resource  green  industry  chain  of  "green  mining-green  refinery-green  application" between upstream and downstream enterprises.

On November 24, 2022, the Company signed a memorandum with ECOPRO and SK On on the investment of the HPAL joint venture with an annual capacity of 30,000 tons of nickel resources in Indonesia. In September 2022, the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, GEM Hong Kong, signed an (Indonesian) joint venture agreement for the annual production of 50,000 tons of nickel matte nickel-containing  metal  with  Weiming  (Hong  Kong)  International  Holdings  Limited,  a  whollyowned subsidiary of Weiming Environment. The Company's controlling subsidiary, QMB, signed a long-term (20 years) green raw material supply agreement for laterite nickel ore with 1.5 million tons  of  nickel  metal  with  a  mine  controlled  by  Australia's  Nickel  Industries  Limited  Mining Company. The projects  will  comprehensively  consolidate  the  Company's  control  of  green  nickel resources,  guaranteeing  the  Company's  strategic  need  for  green  nickel  resources  to  achieve  the long-term goal of selling 500,000 tons of precursors by 2026.

## iv. Advantages in product quality and top market chain

The Company's core products, ternary precursor materials and tricobalt tetraoxide, have become the representatives of the world's high-quality products.

High-nickel,  single-crystal  and  core-shell  ternary  precursor  materials  have  become  the  key  raw materials of ternary materials for power batteries in the world. The Company has become one of the world's few enterprises that can produce high-nickel products of NCM, and NCA series, and taken the lead in realizing the mass production of complete series of products of new generation of 9series high nickel, core-shell high nickel, high voltage ternary, quaternary high nickel, and cobaltfree materials. Meanwhile, the Company took the lead in controlling product quality at the ppb level. Of Serial 8 high-nickel products and above, the magnetic foreign matter in 90% of the was less than 1ppb, making the Company one of the few top enterprises in the world that can control high-nickel precursor materials at the ppb level.

The  Company  has  become  the  mainstream  supplier  of  high-nickel  products  of  global  industry mainstream enterprises, such as SAMSUNG SDI, ECOPRO, XTC New Energy, and Ronbay. Under the  global  pattern  of  industry  market  competition,  the  Company's  ternary  precursors  were comprehensively transformed and upgraded from 5-series and 6-series products to 8-series and 9series high-nickel products, and it broke through high-voltage and core-shell product technologies. The  ternary  precursors  sold  to  the  supply  chain  of  global  leading  power  battery  enterprises accounted for more than 75% of the total volume. Connecting all core power batteries in the world to the global core industry chain of new energy vehicles, the Company has become an indispensable core manufacturing enterprise in the world's new energy supply chain.

## v. Advantages in intelligent, green, and safety and environmental protection management

Adhering to the construction concept of "green, safe, technology-based, high-quality, intelligent and education-oriented" factory, the Company promoted the digital transformation of the factories by implementing  the  "1  +  5"  quality  improvement  projects,  namely,  the  "digital"  brain  quality improvement,  and  the  "technology  process  quality  improvement,  equipment  management  quality improvement, logistics and transportation quality improvement, consumption reduction management quality improvement, and quality management quality improvement" and by arranging the supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), the distributed control  system (DCS), the safety instrument system (SIS), the manufacturing execution system (MES), the quality management system (QMS), the online monitoring system, the video surveillance system and other advanced technical means. The core production line has a smart rate of over 95%. The Company has realized the centralized control of people flow, vehicle flow, logistics, production flow, safety flow  and  environmental  protection  flow,  and  realized  the  whole-procedure  and  full-covered information  connection,  data  connection  and  interconnection  of  the  factories.  Comprehensively controlling  major  safety  risk  points  and  key  environmental  pollution  sources,  the  Company  has realized the traceability, controllability, traceability and predictability of safety and environmental management, comprehensively improved the enterprise safety and environmental management and efficiency, and reduced the safety and environmental protection risks.

GEM's  standardized  operation  and  management  in  the  recycling  of  E-waste,  scrap  vehicles  and power batteries has been recognized by the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the Ministry of Commerce. In addition, the Company has won six national green  factory  honors,  leading  the  peers  in  all  aspects.  GEM's  green,  safe  and  standardized development highlights its leading advantage in the industry.

## (6) Whether the scope of consolidation was changed during the Reporting Period

 Yes □No

(1) Increase in the consolidation scope

1.  In  January 2022, the subsidiary GEM (Jingmen) Nickel-Cobalt Materials Co., Ltd. established Jingmen Huineng Labor Service Co., Ltd., with a registered capital of RMB500,000, holding 100% of  the  shares.  The  new  company  was  included  in  the  consolidation  scope  during  this  Reporting Period.
2. In April 2022, the subsidiary GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt Industry Co., Ltd. acquired Taixing Xinxin Resource Recycling Co., Ltd. through the non-business equity acquisition. The new company has registered capital was RMB26,062,778, and GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt Industry Co., Ltd. holds 100% of  its  shares.  The  new  company  was  included  in  the  consolidation  scope  during  this  Reporting Period.
3.  In  October  2022,  the  subsidiary  Fuan  Qingmei  Energy  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.  established  Ningde Qingmei Trade Co., Ltd. with a registered capital of RMB10 million, holding 60% of the shares. The new company was included in the consolidation scope during this Reporting Period.
4.  In  December  2022,  the  Company  established  GEM  (Shenzhen)  Super  Green  Technology Research Center Co., Ltd. with a registered capital of RMB55 million, holding 100% of the shares. The new company was included in the consolidation scope during this Reporting Period.
- (2) Decrease in the consolidation scope

In  November  2022,  the  Company  deregistered  the  subsidiary  Fengcheng  Meisheng  Renewable Resources  Co.,  Ltd.  The  business  information  changes  were  completed  on  November  10,  2022, upon which the subsidiary would not be included in the consolidation scope.

| Names  of  Main  R&amp;D  Projects  Project Purposes  Project Progress  Objectives  to  Be  Achieved  Expected Impact on the  Future Development of  the Company  9-Series  Core-shell  Precursor  Mass  Production  Development  The project is designed  to  improve  the  safety  level  and  the  recycling  and safety properties of  high-nickel  materials  through  the  internal  high-nickel  and  external  high-  manganese  element  distribution design.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  stage  of stability certification  for  mass  production  batches.  The  project  objectives  include  solving  technical  problems  such  as  core-shell  separation and meeting  customers'  requirements  for  physiochemical  indicators.  The  annual  order  is  expected  to  reach  over  20,000  tons  after  the  project is put into mass  production.  That  will  not  only  contribute  considerable  profits  to  the  Company  but  also  help  it  seize  opportunities  in  the  next-generation  precursor industry.  Industrialization  of  High-voltage  Quaternary Precursors  The project is designed  to  improve  the  capability  of  ternary  materials  in  high-  voltage  conditions  through  the  doping,  coating,  and  structure  design  for  precursors,  The project  has  passed  the  certification  by  customers and has been  put  into  mass  production.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  uniform  distribution  of  doping  and  coating  elements,  meeting  customers'  requirements  for  physiochemical  The  project  will  help  the  Company  acclimatize to the high-  voltage trend of ternary  materials,  diversify  the  Company's  precursor  assembly  lines,  increase the number of   |

Development  of  Precursors  of  Ternary  and  Quaternary  Layered  Oxide  Sodium-ion  Battery  Materials  The project is designed  to  resolve  the  issue  of  differences  in  precipitation  rates  of  multiple  metal  elements,  thereby  achieving  homogeneous  co-  precipitation  of  multiple elements.  The project  has  passed  the  certification  by  customers and has been  put  into  pilot  production.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  homogeneous  co-  precipitation  of  multiple  elements  and  meeting  customers'  requirements  for  physiochemical  indicators.  The  successful  mass  production  of  precursors  of  layered  oxide  sodium-ion  battery  materials  will  help  the  Company  capture  the  market  of  new-generation  sodium-ion  battery  products.  Development  of  the  Co-precipitation  Technology  for  Ultra-  high-nickel  Quinary  Precursors  The project is designed  to  achieve  homogeneous  co-  precipitation  of  five  elements  through  process  parameter  adjustments,  thereby  substantially improving  the  stability  of  crystal  structure  and  the  cycle  property of materials.  The  project  is  experiencing  the  pilot-  scale experiment and is  going  to  proceed  to  mass  production  verification.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  uniform  distribution  of  five  elements,  a  controllable  shape,  and  a  stable  doping  amount.  The project will further  diversify  the  Company's  precursor  assembly  lines  and  promote  the  smooth  development  of  multi-  metal  doped  samples,  and  may  become  one  of the main products of  ultra-high  nickel  doping  in  the  upcoming  one  to  two  years.  R&amp;D  and  Application  of  Small-particle  (3-6  um)  Multi-element  Doped  Cobalt  (II,  III)  Oxide  in  Ammonia-  free  Hydroxyl  Oxidation System  The project is designed  to  inhibit  oxygen  loss  and phase  transition  of  lattice,  improve  the  uniformity  of  the  internal  stress-strain  distribution  of  the  particles, increase layer  spacing  for  better  diffusion  kinetics  characteristics  of  ions,  and  regulate  electronic  band  structure  for  better  electronic  conductivity.  The  lithium  cobalt  oxide  material  based  on  multi-element  doped  tetra-cobalt  has  an  excellent  high-  voltage  electrical  performance.  Additionally,  the  self-  tested  specific  capacity  in  discharging  reaches  204.7  mAh/g,  and  the  retention  rate  reaches  94.91%  after  50  high-  temperature  cycles.  Samples  have  been  sent  to  customers  for  verification.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  uniform  element  distribution,  large  primary  particles  (D50  3.6±0.3  μm),  a  tap  density  of  (TD)  2.5± 0.2  g/cm3,  and  a  BET  surface  area  of  3.5± 1.5 m2/g.  Through  the  effective  regulation  brought  by  the  doping  of  different  elements,  the  project  will  satisfy  customers'  needs for higher energy  density,  power  density,  and  cycle  stability  and  help  the  Company  prepare  for  the  updating and upgrading  of cobalt (II, III) oxide  products.  R&amp;D  and  Application  of  High-rate  Ultra-fine  Aluminum-doped  Cobalt (II, III) Oxide  The project is designed  to  develop  precursors  for  high-rate  lithium  cobalt  oxide  and  prepare  ultra-fine  (2-3  um)  aluminum-doped  cobalt  (II,  III)  oxide  particles.  It  is  also  aimed at improving the  wetting  of  electrolytes  and  the  transmission  performance  of  ion  electrons as well as the  specific  capacity  and  rate  performance  of  Concerning the lithium  cobalt  oxide  material  based  on  ultra-fine  aluminum-doped  cobalt (II, III) oxide, its  high-voltage  specific  capacity  is  6-7  mAh/g  higher  than  that  of  traditional-particle  aluminum-doped  tetra-  cobalt,  and  its  rate  performance  is  improved  by  10%  to  15%.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  uniform  distribution  of  the  aluminum  element,  large  primary  particles  (D50 2-3 μm), a TD of  2.2± 0.2  g/cm3,  and  a  BET  surface  area  of  3.5± 1.5 m2/g.  The  project  will  contribute  to  the  development  of  a  type  of  featured  ultra-fine  aluminum-doped  cobalt  (II,  III)  oxide  materials  based  on  different  needs  for  the  application  of  the  lithium  cobalt  oxide  material,  thereby  diversifying  the  Company's  product  categories  and  strengthening  its   |

Quaternary  Cathode  Material  of  High  Energy Density  The project is designed  to  improve  the  compacted  density,  energy  density,  and  cycle  property  of  materials by employing  the  9-series  quaternary  polycrystalline  doped  with  9-series  quaternary  monocrystalline,  and  heighten  the  output  stability of batteries.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  stage  of  mass  production  certification,  and  the  product  leads  China  in  performance.  The  project  objectives  include  applying  a  compacted density of ≥  3.60  g/cm3,  a  full-  battery  capacity  per  gram of  ＞  210 mAh/g  at  0.33  C,  ≥  2,000  cycles  at  room  temperature,  and  ≥  1,200 cycles at 45℃.  In  consideration  of  the  advantages  of  NCM  and  NCA,  the  quaternary  cathode  material  will  fully  replace the mainstream  cathode  materials  in  the  market  in  terms  of  technology,  performance,  and  cost.  It  is  a  new-generation  product  of  technological  innovation,  as  well  as  the  next-generation  flagship  product  of  most  battery  enterprises.  Cathode  Materials  for  Sodium-ion  Batteries  Based  on  the  Layered  Oxide System  The project is designed  to  develop  the  cathode  materials  for  sodium-  ion  batteries  based  on  the  layered  oxide  structure  and  replace  some  of  the  existing  lead-acid  and  lithium-  ion  battery  systems  in  two-wheeled  vehicles  and  energy  storage  with this material.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  stage  of  mass  production  certification,  and  the  product  leads  China  in  performance.  The  project  objectives  include  substantially  reducing  the  material  cost  by  approximately  30%  based  on  the  existing  lithium-ion  batteries  and  achieving  a  full-battery  capacity  per  gram  of  more  than  125 mAh/g.  With  the  Group's  strengths in precursors,  the  project  will  drastically  shorten  the  development  cycle,  expedite  the  industrialization  of  the  cathode  materials  for  sodium-ion  batteries,  and  help  the  Group  capture  the  markets  of  two-wheeled  vehicles  and  energy  storage  as  well as gain leadership  in the industry.  Development  of  Low-  Co  and  High-power  Ternary Materials  The project is designed  to  replace  the  conventional  5-series  high-power  products,  thereby  capturing  the  electric  tool  market  with  high  cost-  effectiveness.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  stage  of  mass  production  certification,  and  the  product  leads  China  in  performance.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  a  capacity  of  more  than  166  mAh/g  for  4.2  V  batteries at 0.2 C and a  discharge  cycle  retention  rate  at  10  C  of  more  than  600  cycles.  Considering  the  increasing  cost  of  batteries  for  digital  electric  tools,  the  project  will  help  the  Company  lead  the  industry through a cost  reduction  with  low-Co  materials  and  thus  capture the mainstream  customers in the digital  market earlier.  Development  of  NCA  Materials  for  High-end  Electric Tools  The NCA material uses  the  Ni/Co  binary  precursor that is doped  with  aluminum  and  then  sintered.  Additionally, the large-  and  small-grain  composition  is  employed  to  improve  the  compaction  performance  of  the  materials.  Concurrently,  the  non-  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  stage  of  mass  production  certification,  and  the  product  leads  China  in  performance.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  the  large-  and  small-grain  composition  and  the  non-washing  process  and  ensuring  that  the  residual  alkali  is  ≤  0.8  wt%,  that  the  compacted  density  is  above  3.6  g/cm3,  and  that  the  capacity  per  gram  is  ≥  192  mAh/g  for  4.25  V  batteries  at  Compared  with  the  NCM  material,  the  NCA  material  is  more  advantageous  in  the  field  of  high-end  electric  tools  in  terms  of  the  cathode  energy  density  and  safety  performance. Equipped  with  the  non-washing  process,  the  material  can  drastically  lower  the  product  cost.   |

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| washing  process  reduces  the  material's  electrical  impedance  and cost.  0.2 C.  Additionally,  the  material's  performance  and  cost-effectiveness  will  become  a  critical  materials  guarantee  for  domestic  batteries  for  electric tools.  Comprehensive  Recycling  of  Valuable  Elements  in  the  Used  Lithium Iron Phosphate  Batteries  The project is designed  to  recycle  the  valuable  elements  in  the  used  lithium  iron  phosphate  black  powder  using  green,  low-cost  techniques  and  redevelop  battery-  grade  iron(III)  phosphate  and  lithium  carbonate. By doing so,  the project will remove  the  current  technological  bottlenecks  in  the  industry.  Part  of  the  project  has  been industrialized.  The  project  objectives  include  redeveloping  15,000 tons of battery-  grade lithium carbonate  and  50,000  tons  of  battery-grade  iron(III)  phosphate  with  the  used  lithium  iron  phosphate  as  raw  materials a year.  The  project  will  help  the  Company  take  the  lead  in  breaking  through  in  the  reasonable  techniques  for  disposing  of  the  used  lithium  iron  phosphate  batteries,  thereby  removing  the  technological  bottlenecks  in  the  industry  in  the  recycling  and  disposal  of iron and phosphorus  elements.  Additionally,  the  industrialized  mass  production  of  the  project will level up the  Company's  international  status  in  the  E-waste  recycling  field.  Preparation  of  Highly  Pure  Nickel  through  Electrodeposition  The project is designed  to develop the "electric  field-temperature  field-  stream  field"  coupled  technology and achieve  the  industrialized  application  of  highly  pure  nickel  prepared  from  the  complex  nickel-containing  solution.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  industrialized  application.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  stable  and  controllable  quality  of  the  appearances  of  nickel  plates  produced,  meeting national grade-  1  nickel  standards  in  terms of the main metal  and  impurity  content,  and  achieving  an  annual  output  of  30,000 tons of nickel.  The  project  will  diversify  the  Company's products on  sale,  improve  the  Company's  profiting  model, and enhance the  Company's  capability  of  resisting  market  risks.  Technology  for  Industrialized  Efficient  Enrichment  of  Nickel  and  Cobalt  in  the  Laterite Nickel Ore and  MHP Preparation  The project is designed  to  extract  nickel  and  cobalt  in  a  highly  selective  manner  from  the tough laterite nickel  ore  classified  as  limonite  and  prepare  the  nickel-cobalt  intermediate,  MHP,  which serves as the raw  materials  of  the  Company's products.  The  project  has  proceeded  to  the  industrialized  application.  The project objective is  to  produce conforming  nickel-cobalt  intermediate,  MHP,  on  an ongoing basis.  The  steady  supply  of  nickel  and  cobalt  raw  materials  is  critical  to  the  Company.  If  the  technology  for  preparing  MHP  from  stable  laterite  nickel  ores  at  a  lower  cost  is  developed to ensure the  steady  supply  of  low-  cost  nickel  and  cobalt  raw  materials  to  the  Company,  the  Company's  international  status  in  the  new  energy  field  will be solidified. R&amp;D  of  Intelligent  Disassembling  Equipment  for  End-of-  life Power Batteries  The project is designed  to  achieve  flexible  and  intelligent  disassembling  of  end-  of-life  power  batteries  of  multiple  type  and  small batches and their  parts  and  components  through  AI,  machine  vision,  and  industrial  machines.  The  data  collection  system  and  the  core  data  library  for  the  disassembling  of  27  types  of  battery  packages  have  been  developed.  Additionally,  the  deep  learning-based  object  detection algorithm has  been  developed,  with  the  successful  disassembling  rate  of  screws  reaching  more  than 95%.  The  project  objectives  include  developing  whole-procedure  intelligent  disassembling  equipment  and  achieving  efficient,  flexible,  and  green  disassembling  of  end-  of-life  power  batteries  with  similar  structures  and  disassembling  processes,  of  multiple  types,  and  in  small  batches.  The  project  will  achieve  intelligent,  flexible,  and  efficient  disassembling  of  end-  of-life  power  batteries,  improve  recycling  efficiency,  reduce  recycling  costs,  and  boost  the  Company's  competitiveness  in  the  industry  and  its  core  technologies.  Quick  Sorting  Technology  and  Equipment  for  the  Cascade  Utilization  of  End-of-life  Power  Batteries  The project is designed  to  develop  the  quick  sorting  technology  and  equipment  for  the  cascade  utilization  of  end-of-life  power  batteries  through  electrochemical  mechanism-based  parameter  acquisition,  modeling,  and  SOH/SOC anticipation.  The  non-destructive  testing  has  been  capable  of  being  completed  in  30  minutes  with  accuracy  reaching  97%.  Additionally,  equipment  for  non-  destructive  testing  and  quick  sorting  has  been  developed,  with  the  sorting  efficiency  reaching 180 pieces per  hour.  The  project  objectives  include  shortening  the  quick  sorting  process  by  more  than  40%  in  comparison  to  conventional programs,  achieving  sorting  accuracy  of  more  than  98%,  and  obviously  reducing sorting costs.  The project will fill the  gap  in  sorting  equipment,  and  the  full-lifecycle  data  library  will  contribute  to  the  reduction  in  the  costs of the Company's  products  for  cascade  utilization  and  raise  technological barriers.  Key  Technology  for  Efficient  Separation  of  Active  Materials  and  Ultra-thin  Metals  of  End-of-life  Power  Batteries  The project is designed  to  develop  new  technology  for  the  separation  of  battery  materials  and  reduce  the  impurities  in  black  powder and the energy  consumption  of  the  separation.  The  heating  process  during  the  separation  of  lithium  iron  phosphate  sheet  electrodes  has  been  shortened by 40%, and  the purity values of the  recycled  active  materials  and  aluminum  foil  have  reached  more  than  99.1%  and  89.3%,  respectively.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  the  purity  values  of  the  recycled  active  materials  and  aluminum foil  of  more  than 99.6% and 99.2%,  respectively,  and  reducing  energy  consumption by 20%.  The  technology  will  substantially  shorten  the  heating  process,  reduce  energy  consumption,  and  reduce  costs  and  increase  the  efficiency  of the assembly lines.  Digital  Diagnosis  of  Large  Crushers  for  Scrap Vehicles  The project is designed  to  carry  out  digital  upgrading  of  the  crushers  for  scrap  vehicles,  minimize  The  deployment  of  audio, vibration, speed,  and torque sensors and  the collection of failure  features  have  been  The  project  objectives  include  as  follows:  After  the  crusher  goes  through  the  intelligent  upgrading,  the  sudden  The  technology  will  achieve  the  digital  upgrading  of  large  crushers,  thus  bringing  about  lower  vehicle   |

The  production  efficiency  will  be  boosted  by  more than 20%.  scrapping  costs  and  higher  production  efficiency.  Research  on  the  Technology  for  the  Development  of  High-  performance  Lithium-  ion  Battery  Cathode  Materials  through  Atomic  Layer  Deposition  The project is designed  to  stabilize  the  surface  structure  of  cathode  materials  through  nano-oxide/solid-state  electrolyte  coating,  thereby lengthening the  materials'  cycle  life  while  ensuring  a  high  energy density.  Concerning the 9-series  high-nickel  and  96-  series  ultra-high-nickel  cathode  materials,  the  in-situ/non-in-situ  atomic layer deposition  coating  of  various  metal  oxides  has  been  conducted,  and  the  mass  production  in  the  industry  has  been  surveyed.  Seven  applications  for  national  patents  have  been filed.  The  project  objectives  include  developing  cathode  materials  of  a  high  specific  volume  (≥  215  mAh/g),  high  initial  efficiency  (≥  88%),  and  long  cycle  stability  (with  a  cycle  life of ≥ 1500 cycles at  1  C  current  density),  such as 96-series ultra-  high-nickel  cathode  material  LiNi0.96Co0.03Mn0.0  1O2.  As  the  best  coating  technology  so  far,  atomic layer deposition  technology  is  one  of  the  critical  channels  of  bringing  batteries  of  a  high  energy  density  and long cycle life into  reality.  Additionally,  the  technology  will  promote  the  Company's  industry-  university-research  cooperation  in  depth.  As  a  type  of  reserve  technology,  the  technology  can  be  swiftly  put  into  industrialized  production,  thereby  providing  technological  support  for  the  Company's  production of high-end  power battery products.  Modification  Research  on  Graphene-coated  Lithium Iron Phosphate  The project is designed  to  strengthen  the  electronic  conductivity  among  particles  by  coating the lithium iron  phosphate  cathode  materials  with  graphene,  thereby  solving  the  issue  of  weak  electric  conductivity  of  lithium  iron  phosphate  and  improving  its  rate  and  low-temperature  performance.  The  development  of  the  first  formulation  at  the  lab-scale  test  stage  has been completed.  The  project  objectives  include  achieving  a  specific  capacity  of  &gt;  160  mAh/g  at  a  discharge rate of 0.1 C,  the  initial  efficiency  of  &gt;  99%,  and  a  specific  capacity  of  &gt;  150  mAh/g  after  200  cycles  of  charging  and  discharging  at  1  C  in  terms  of  the  coated  lithium iron phosphate.  At a low temperature (-  30℃)  and  0.2  C,  the  capacity  retention  rate  will  be  ＞  90%  after  200 cycles.  The  project  will  provide  technological  reserves  for  Fuan  Qingmei  Energy  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.  in  the  industrialization  of  lithium  iron  phosphate  in  the  upcoming  few  years.  The  process  parameters  at  the  lab-  scale  test  stage  can  be  debugged  and  scaled  up  for  the  pilot  scale,  doing  so  to  satisfy  customers'  demand  for  high-rate  lithium  iron  phosphate  cathode  materials.  R&amp;D  and  Application  of  PtCo/C  Catalyst  for  Hydrogen  Fuel  Batteries  The project is designed  to  replace  part  of  the  precious  metal  Pt  with  Co to prepare the high-  performance  PtCo  alloy  catalyst. Explanation  of  hedging  effect  In order to improve the Company's ability to deal with the risk of exchange rate and interest rate fluctuations and  reduce the impact on the Company's operating profit, the Company conducts foreign exchange derivatives trading  business according to the actual business situation. The scale of the foreign exchange derivatives trading business  carried out matches the Company's actual business scale. Speculative operations will not affect the Company's  daily operations and the development of its main business.  Capital  source  of  derivatives  investment  Owned fund  Description  of  risk  analysis  and  control  measures  for  derivatives  positions  during  the  Reporting  Period  (including  but  not  limited  to  market  risk,  liquidity risk,  credit  risk,  operational  risk,  and  legal risk)  1. Risk analysis of foreign exchange derivative transaction business  The Company carries out foreign exchange derivative transaction business in accordance with the principle of  locking exchange rate and interest rate risks and does not engage in speculative operations. However, there are  still certain risks in the foreign exchange derivative transaction business:  - (1)  Market  risk:  The  difference  between  the  exchange  rate  and  interest  rate  of  foreign  exchange  derivative transaction contracts and the actual exchange rate and interest rate on the maturity date will result in transaction gains or losses. During the outstanding maturities of foreign exchange derivatives, revaluation gains and losses will  be  generated in each accounting period, and the accumulated value of revaluation gains and losses to the maturity date is equal to the transaction gains and losses.  - (2)  Performance risk: The foreign exchange derivative transaction business is based on the Company's foreign exchange  assets  and  liabilities,  which  match  the  actual  foreign  exchange  receipts  and  disbursements,  and sufficient capital settlement at the time of delivery needs to be guaranteed. The Company forecasts the payment according  to  the  expected  order.  During  the  actual  execution,  the  customer  may  adjust  the  order,  resulting  in inaccurate  payment  forecasts  of  the  Company,  or  the  customer's  accounts  receivable  are  overdue,  resulting  in failure  to  recover  payment  within  the  predicted  payment  period.  The  above  situation  will  lead  to  the  risk  of delayed delivery because the funds cannot meet the clearing requirements.  - (3)  Internal  control  risk:  Imperfect  internal  control  policies  probably  trigger  risks  to  the  foreign  exchange derivative transaction business, as it is highly professional and complex.   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| 2. Risk control measures to be taken by the Company  (1)  The  Finance  Department  of  the  Company  tracks  and  manages  the  exchange  rate  trend  and  exchange  rate  information, and feeds back the information to the sales and purchasing departments of the Company as the basis  or reference for the price negotiation of export products and imported materials.  (2) The Finance Department of the Company regularly obtains the forward exchange rate and valuation results  provided  by  banks.  In  addition,  it  seeks  different  quotations  from  other  counterparties  and  conducts  cross-  checking, regularly reviews the results of executed contracts, and timely adjusts the foreign exchange derivative  transaction business.  (3)  The  Company  has  formulated  the  Management  Policies  for  Foreign  Exchange  Derivative  Transaction  Business of GEM Co., Ltd., which clearly defines the operating principles, approval authority, internal operating  procedures,  internal  risk  reporting  system  and  risk  processing  program  of  foreign  exchange  derivative  transactions.  Business  risks  are  controlled  for  the  foreign  exchange  derivative  transaction  business  in  strict  accordance with the operating principles, approval authority, internal control procedures, internal risk reporting  system and risk processing program of the Management Policies for Foreign Exchange Derivative Transaction  Business of GEM Co., Ltd.  (4)  In  order  to  prevent  the  delayed  delivery  of  foreign  exchange  derivative  transactions,  the  main  business  departments of the Company track the sales and purchases on a rolling basis and regularly report to the Finance  Department. In case of any large changes in the predicted orders of major customers, the sales revenue forecast  will  be  updated  in  a  timely  manner  and  reported  to  the  Finance  Department.  At  the  same  time,  the  Company  attaches great importance to the management of accounts receivable, actively collects accounts receivable, and  avoids overdue accounts receivable.  (5)  The  internal  audit  department  of  the  Company  will  regularly  and  irregularly  check  the  signing  and  implementation of the actual transaction contract.  For  changes  in  market  prices  or  fair  value  of  invested  derivatives  during  the  Reporting  Period,  and  the  analysis  of  the  fair  value  of  derivatives,  the  Company  should  disclose  the  specific  methods  used,  relevant  assumptions  and  parameter  setting  The Company's accounting for the fair value of derivatives is mainly for the outstanding contracts of forward  exchange  settlement  and  sale  entered  into  by  the  Company  with  banks  during  the  Reporting  Period.  The  Company determines the fair value on the balance sheet date based on the notification of market value issued by  the bank. Explanation of the Overall Use of the Raised Funds

The Company received a document titled Reply concerning the Approval to the Non-public Offering of Shares by GEM Co., Ltd. (ZH.J.X.K. [2019] No. 2006) from the CSRC, which approved the Company to non-publicly offer 634,793,184 RMB ordinary shares  (A  share)  at  RMB3.82  per  share  to  28  specific  targets.  Through  this  issuance,  the  Company  raised  funds  of RMB2,424,909,962.88 in total. With the issuance expenses deducted, the net funds raised amounted to RMB2,386,512,911.01. Asia Pacific (Group) CPAs (Special General Partnership) verified the aforementioned raised funds on April 24, 2020 and issued the Capital  Verification  Report (Y.H.A.Y.Z.  [2020]  No.  0021).  By  December  31,  2022,  the  raised  funds  invested  totaled RMB2,398,908,700, and the closing balance of the raised funds in the special account was 37,341.67

With  the  approvals  of  a  document  titled Reply  concerning  the  Approval  to  the  Initial  Public  Offering  of  Global  Depositary Receipts and Listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange by GEM Co., Ltd. (ZH.J.X.K. [2022] No. 1298) from the CSRC and a document titled Decision on GEM Co., Ltd. from SIX Exchange Regulation AG, the Company was approved by CSRC to issue no more than 478,352,225 new A-share ordinary shares corresponding to Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs). According to the conversion ratio determined by the Company, the number of GDRs issued shall not exceed 47,835,222. 28,184,100 GDRs were issued in the Company's  initial  offering,  2,818,400  GDRs  were  over-allotted,  and  the  issue  price  was  USD12.28  per  GDR.  Through  this issuance, the Company raised funds of USD380,710,700 in total, which was converted to RMB2,524,810,801.85 based on the central  parity  price  of  RMB-to-USD  rate  on  the  date  of  receipt  of  the  funds  raised.  By  December  31,  2022,  the  raised  funds invested totaled RMB1,745,406,865.07 and the closing balance of the raised funds in the special account was 884,421,278.45.

Occurred in the prior year

On April 26, 2021, the Company held the 28th Meeting of the Fifth Board of Directors and the 22nd Meeting of the Fifth Board of Supervisors, where the Proposal on Altering Some Raised Fund Investment Projects was reviewed and approved. According to the proposal, the intended use of the raised funds for the raised fund investment project "Power battery ternary cathode material project (annual output of 50,000 tons of power ternary material precursor raw materials and 20,000 tons of ternary cathode material)" was altered. In other words, some raised funds for the project mentioned above were used for the new raised fund investment project "Indonesian nickel laterite ore chemical project for batteries (nickel sulfate crystal) (with an annual capacity of 50,000 tons of nickel)" and for the permanent replenishment of liquid capital. Additionally, the original raised fund investment project "power battery ternary cathode material project (annual capacity: 50,000 tons of raw materials-precursor-for ternary materials of power batteries, and 20,000 tons of ternary cathode  materials)"  was  implemented  by  Fuan  Qingmei  Energy  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.  at  New  Metallurgical  Material Industrial Park, Wanwuxi Area, Fuan of Ningde, Fujian Province. The new raised fund investment project "Indonesian nickel  laterite  ore  chemical  project  for  batteries  (nickel  sulfate  crystal)  (with  an  annual  capacity  of  50,000  tons  of nickel)" was implemented by the Company's subsidiary PT.QMB New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. at China-Indonesia Integrated Industrial Park Tsingshan Park, Morowali, Central Sulawesi, the Republic of Indonesia. On May 13, 2021, the  above-mentioned  proposal  was  deliberated  and  passed  at  the  Company's  2020  Annual  General  Meeting  of Shareholders.

On May 13, 2021, the above-mentioned proposal was deliberated and passed at the Company's 2020 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. For details, please read the Declaration on Altering Some Raised Fund Investment Projects and the Declaration on the Resolutions of the 2020 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders published  by  the  Company on  Cninfo  (http://www.cninfo.com.cn)  on  April  28,  2021  and May 14, 2021, respectively.   |

## XI. Outlook for the Future Development of the Company

A low-carbon future will be created with more than two decades of recycling. In the future, GEM will  adhere  to  the  industrial  strategy  driven  by  the  dual  tracks  of  "new  energy  materials manufacturing + urban mining". Meanwhile, through developing new energy materials and mining urban mines, GEM will strongly serve the world economic recovery, serve global carbon emission reduction  and  carbon  neutrality,  strive  to  curb  the  greenhouse  effect,  and  create  a  world-leading enterprise with green and low-carbon development. With these efforts, GEM will build itself into an undertaker  of  green  development,  a  leader  of  the  low-carbon  era,  a  core  enterprise  of  the  new energy industry and a booster of global economic recovery and make the contribution of a Chinese enterprise to the Glasgow Climate Agreement and the green development and recovery of the world.

## i. Strategic development goals for 2023-2026

From 2023 to 2026, the Company will implement the "super-technology and digital" strategy to empower "new energy materials manufacturing + urban mining" and drive the Company to become an industry-leading technology innovation company and a digital operation company with efficient management.

## The Company will strive to record a sales revenue of more than RMB80 billion by 2026.

From 2023 to 2026, the Company will implement the "3+2" development strategy in the business field of new energy materials, consolidate the global core position of three core business types (raw material system, precursor and tricobalt tetraoxide), and develop the two emerging business types of sodium electric materials and solid lithium electric cathode materials with big strides. Moreover, the

Company will implement the "3+1" development strategy in the business field of urban mining, make the three urban mining business types of "Power Regeneration, Green Recycling and Green Tungsten Resource" bigger and stronger, and actively develop the urban mining business of scrap vehicle recycling.

## The Company's operation goals for various business types by 2026 are as follows:

## 1. Goals for the new energy material business:

The production capacity of ternary precursors will reach 500,000 tons;

The production capacity of tricobalt tetraoxide will reach 30,000 tons;

The production capacity of sodium electric materials will reach more than 50,000 tons;

The production capacity of lithium-iron phosphate materials will reach more than 200,000 tons.

Production Capacity and Scale Goals of New Energy Materials by 2026

## 2. Goals for the power battery recycling business:

The scale of power battery recycling will reach more than 300,000 tons;

The sales volume of the power battery recycling business will reach more than RMB10 billion.

Goals for the Chemistry System of Nickel, Cobalt and Manganese by 2026

<!-- image -->

From 2023 to 2026, the Company will cooperate with global upstream and downstream to actively promote the Battery Passport Plan, establish a directional cycle cooperation relationship with global automobile  factories  and  battery  factories  under  the  directional  recycling  mode,  and  build  the whole-life cycle value chain of new energy of "power battery recycling - recycling of nickel, cobalt and  lithium  resources  -  remanufacturing  of  precursor  materials  -  remanufacturing  of  cathode materials - cascade utilization of power batteries".

From 2023 to 2036, the Company will take Jiangxi, Wuhan, Henan, Shanxi and Inner Mongolia as the core bases to develop the urban mining business with E-waste and waste plastic recycling as the main body, vigorously promote the development of a recycling society, and serve the carbon peak and carbon neutrality strategy.

From 2023 to 2036, the Company will fully implement the zero-carbon plan of the industrial chain, actively  promote  the  carbon  emission  peak  and  carbon  neutrality  strategy  and  work  with  stateowned energy companies to build 10,000 mu of PV power and plant 10,000 mu of carbon-neutral forest. By 2026, 1 million tons of carbon reduction will be achieved, the utilization rate of green electricity  will  reach  50%,  and  a  low-carbon  demonstration  park  and  a  waste-free  Group  will  be created.

The Company will actively boost the waste recycling and carbon reduction labeling and the carbon sink labeling of 10,000 mu of carbon-neutral forest, implement carbon value reduction and carbon sink trading, achieve carbon benefits, promote the upgrading of waste recycling from "turning waste into treasure" to "turning waste into carbon sink", and raise the green value of the Company from selling recycled resources to selling "carbon sinks".

From  2023  to  2026,  the  Company  will  comprehensively  promote  clean  production,  energy conservation  and  emission  reduction,  unit  energy  consumption  will  decrease  by  35%,  unit  water consumption will decrease by 50%, VOCs will be recovered by 100%, and COD will decrease by 30%.

## ii. Work plan for 2023

In 2023, GEM will bravely face the severe challenges of global industry competition and involution, seek  opportunities  amid  global  competition,  and  stay  invincible  in  global  competition.  The Company will focus on the implementation of six stabilization measures, including stabilizing the fighting  atmosphere,  stabilizing  the  development  environment,  stabilizing  the  capital chain, stabilizing  the  industrial  chain,  stabilizing  the  sales  scale,  and  stabilizing  profitability.  Taking "striding  towards  a  new  journey  with  innovation  leadership,  cost  reduction,  quality  improvement and efficiency enhancement" as the working motto, innovation leadership and quality first as the main line, the comprehensive promotion of digital upgrading as the basis, the nickel resource raw material  system  as  the  foundation,  and  cost  reduction,  quality  improvement  and  efficiency enhancement as the levers, the Company will thoroughly implement the "3+2" strategy of the new energy  material  business  and  the  "3+1"  project  of  the  urban  mining  business,  comprehensively deepen global competitiveness from the strategic and tactical point of view, and promote the release of the Company's various business capacities and the high growth in efficiency once again.

## 1)  Promote  innovation  leadership  and  quality  first,  implement  the  "zero-defect"  quality action plan, and carry out the plan to multiply innovation results.

## The  Company  will  implement  the  "world-class  and  zero-defect  factory"  action  plan  for surrendering documents in time and stabilizing customers.

## The Company will implement the innovation leadership plan and make its core business and emerging business fully lead the industry.

In 2023, on the basis of increased innovative facilities in 2022, the Company will implement the plan  to  multiply  innovation  results,  carry  out  innovation  competition  among  research  institutes, shorten the innovation cycle, multiply the innovation results, enhance the leading role of innovative research  of  the  core  business  in  the  industry,  and  fully  guarantee  the  leading  position  of  the Company's various businesses in the industry.

## 2) Standardize governance, enhance the brand, and sublimate value.

In  2023,  with  "cost,  standardization  and  performance"  as  the  main  line,  the  Company  will  take digital  means  to  carry  out  internal  audits  and  supervision,  implement  the  discipline  rectification movement, regain the spirit of struggle, and ensure that the Company moves towards a new stage of standardization, low cost and efficient operation. Meanwhile, the Company will comprehensively promote  the  digital  management  of  financial  management,  purchase  management,  engineering management and business procedures. Training on standardized governance, business procedures and  financial  fundamentals  will  be  continuously  carried  out  to  enhance  the  standard  level  of  all operation personnel and build the Company into a listed company with excellent governance.

In  2023,  the  Company  will  actively  carry  out  global  investor  exchange  and  value  promotion activities based on the global industrial park and invite minority shareholders worldwide to enter the  GEM  Global  Park.  The  Company  will  conduct  the  core  business  of  core  shareholders  and external directors, especially independent directors, entering the core park and the Company, so as to acquire a dynamic understanding of the core park and core business, boost interaction, enhance understanding,  gather  strength,  and  promote  the  Company  to  make  steady  progress  and  achieve long-term goals. Meanwhile, the Company will constantly improve the system of three boards and corporate  governance,  make  proper  pre-communication  and  pre-exchange  on  major  issues,  and promote the high-quality development of corporate governance institutions.

## 3)  Comprehensively  promote  digitalization  and  implement  the  precise  goal  management  of "cost reduction, quality improvement and efficiency enhancement".

In  2023,  the  Company  will  continue  to  follow  the  principle  of  "focusing  the  brain  on  digits", implement  digital  upgrading,  move  from  digital  pilot  to  all-round  digital  operation,  and  build  a globally advanced digital operation company.

On  the  basis  of  the  digital  pilot  project  in  2022,  the  Company  will,  in  2023,  promote  digital management to all workshops, all factories, all business procedures and all management procedures of  the  Company,  open  up  data  and  connect  information,  implement  the  digital  operation  of production,  business  and  management,  achieve  goal  digitization  and  implement  digitization  and appraisal digitization, put a complete end to blind spots in production and management, improve production  and  management  efficiency,  and  boost  "cost  reduction,  quality  improvement  and

efficiency enhancement". The digital means will be taken to precisely implement "cost reduction, quality improvement and efficiency enhancement", that is, to precisely implement the goal-oriented management of "precise goal planning, precise goal implementation, and precise goal assessment", reduce consumption and cost with a revolutionary mentality, realize dancing on the needle tip, and challenge the limit.

## 4) Cultivate and introduce talented persons at all levels and reform the remuneration system to satisfy the  needs of  global  competition  and  serve  the  Company's  global  business development.

In 2023, the training plan for 3,000 craftsmen and mechanics of the core business will be solidly pushed forward to create an industrial team for the raw material system and material manufacturing system with global competitiveness. Efforts will be made to cultivate and assess leading talented persons and innovative figures, make good use of these persons, and encourage them to play the head wild goose effect.

The Company will implement the incentive system of reforming the dividend right in all businesses and  implement  the  management  system  of  "sharing  responsibilities  and  benefits"  with  all  core employees, thereby promoting responsibility, innovation vitality and efficiency improvement.

## 5)  Strengthen  safety  and  environmental  protection  and  deeply  promote  the  construction  of "Technology + Intelligence + Green + Safety" factories.

With the alarm of safety and environmental protection ringing all the time, the Company will not relax at any time and will build "Technology + Intelligence + Green + Safety" factories by strictly following  the  environmental  protection  concept  of  "no  production  in  case  of  no  environmental protection" and the safety concept of "no operation in case of no safety".

The Company will solidly set up the Group's safety and environmental protection supervision and inspection office to be in charge of supervising the Company's safety production management and environmental governance, resolutely control the safety and environmental hazards, and dynamically eliminate the hidden dangers of safety and environmental governance.

The Company will take the digital means to implement the action of environmental governance to every  process  and  safety  without  dead  ends  and  deeply  promote  the  safety  and  environmental governance with processes as the main body.

The  Company  will  continue  to  push  forward  the  in-depth  governance  of  water  recycling,  solid waste recycling and organic matter emission reduction  and  create factories with water  recycling, standardized  utilization  of  solid  waste  and  no  smell,  Among  them,  unit  energy  consumption decreased by 20%, unit water consumption decreased by 20%, VOCs recycling rate was 100%, and COD decreased by 20%.

The Company will plant green forests to reduce carbon emissions, comprehensively enhance the greening  planning  of  each  park,  carry  out  low-carbon  upgrading  planning,  and  promote  the construction of low-carbon demonstration parks step by step.

The  Company  will  implement  production-oriented  safety  management  and  responsibility  for keeping  the  land,  carry  out  a  major  rectification  campaign  on  "safety,  site  and  occupational environment", comprehensively deepen safety governance, and consolidate the bottom line of safety.

In addition, the quality and value of various auxiliary products will be upgraded to generate benefits from such products.

## iii. Analysis of the main risks faced by the Company and its countermeasures

## 1. Economic and policy risks in the macroenvironment

At present, the competition in the world industry is intensifying. "Green + Safety + Intelligence" need  for  world  economic  recovery  and  development.  A  number  of  intelligent  plants,  intelligent logistics and intelligent models, as well as data technology-based interconnectivity, have sprung up with  digitalization.  To  rise  to  the  profound  changes  in  the  global  industry  chain  and  industry competition,  we  will  adhere  to  the  "green,  safe,  technology-based,  high-quality,  intelligent  and education-oriented"  park  standards  and  endeavor  to  build  workshops  that  emphasize  process, automation,  cleanliness,  safety,  information  technology,  and  education.  Additionally,  we  will explore technologies and quality to promote innovative and high-quality development by persevering  in  striving  for  groundbreaking  breakthroughs  in  technology  and  quality  of  principal products and core business, the Company will secure a victory in the three tough battles-"business upgrade, quality upgrade, and efficiency upgrade", and achieve high-efficiency development.

## 2. Risk of fiercer industry competition

The green industry guided by " emission peak and carbon neutrality" and new energy consumption will  become one of the largest emerging industries in the future. Accordingly, global capital and talent  will  be  concentrated  therein.  This  will  cause  over-investment  and  over-capacity,  lead  the industry  chain  to  converge  on  the  leading  market.  Under  the  more  severe  industry  competition pattern,  the  Company will control  the  core  technology  through  innovation  leadership  and  quality priority  plan,  and  consolidate  the  global  resource  chain  and  value  chain  to  create  global  core competitiveness in the fields of new energy materials and nickel and cobalt resources, comprehensively implement the "3+2" strategy of the new energy material business and the "3+1" project  of  the  urban  mining  business,  thereby  hedging  against  various  competitive  risks  in  the industry and maintaining the steady growth of the core business.

## 3. Management risk

The  increasingly  large  business  scale,  continuously  extended  industry  chain,  and  the  increasing

number of employees and branches have increased the risks arising from the safety, environmental and  operation  management.  Therefore,  the  Company  will  promote  information-based,  intelligent construction through digital upgrading, thereby achieving the intelligent management of information flow, data connection and interconnectivity, and responding to miscellaneous management risks. At the same time, the Company will strengthen the development of the internal control  system  and  the  management  of  financial  and  business  process  standards,  and  carry  out "working  discipline  and  working  style  reform"  and  management  revolution.  By  doing  so,  the Company will awaken the desire of all the management members to struggle, enhance their duty performance  capabilities  and  duty  awareness,  control  miscellaneous  risks,  and  maximize  the protection of the interests of shareholders and small and medium-sized investors.

## 4. Financial risk

Facing  a  constantly  changing  global  economic  situation,  the  Company  should  maintain  prudent operation and stable cash flow. Besides, we will enter a new stage of high-quality development and improve  business  profitability  by  winning  the  three  major  battles-"business  upgrade,  quality upgrade, and efficiency upgrade". We will stabilize cash flow and achieve stable operations through various  measures  such  as  increasing  inventory  turnover,  more  rigorous  receivables  management, increasing income and reducing expenditure, controlling debt ratio, and expanding capital pool, etc.

To  sum  up,  despite  the  relatively  challenging  global  industry  competitive  pattern  and  challenges arising  from  miscellaneous  external  risks  in  2023  and  the  future,  the  Company  will  continue  to focus on its  own business, implementing refined management, controlling risks,  creating its core competitiveness, and seizing market opportunities. By responding to the external uncertainties with certainties, the Company will repay its investors with constantly prudent operating results.
