## Section IV Corporate Governance

## I. Basic Information on Corporate Governance

The Company strictly follows the requirements of the Company Law , the Securities Law , the Code of Corporate Governance for Listed Companies , the Listing Rules of Shenzhen Stock Exchange , and other  relevant  laws  and  regulations  issued  by  the  CSRC  and  the  Shenzhen  Stock  Exchange.  It formulates the Articles of Association and other internal control rules and regulations, improves the Company's internal corporate governance structure,  strengthens  internal  management  and  control systems,  and  standardizes  corporate  behavior.  As  of  the  end  of  the  Reporting  Period,  the  actual situation of the Company's governance complies with the normative document requirements for the governance of listed  companies  issued  by  the  CSRC  and  the  Shenzhen  Stock  Exchange,  and  no relevant  documents  have  been  received  from  the  regulatory  authorities  adopting  administrative supervision measures.

With  regard  to  the  Company's  GDRs,  generally,  the  SIX  Directive  on  Information  Relating  to Corporate  Governance  of  June  20,  2019,  as  amended  (the  " DCG ")  is  binding  on  all  Swiss companies whose equity securities have their primary or main listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange. As per the listing rules of the SIX Swiss Exchange (the " Listing Rules of SIX "), the DCG is not applicable regarding an issuer of global depositary receipts. The Listing Rules of SIX provide that an issuer of the underlying shares of global depositary receipts shall declare in its annual reports following  the  listing  of  global  depositary  receipts,  that  it  adheres  to  the  corporate  governance standards of its domestic markets. The Company complies with the corporate governance standards of Shenzhen Stock Exchange, its domestic market for the A Shares.

## 1. Shareholders and General Meeting of Shareholders

During the Reporting Period, the Company strictly adhered to the requirements of the Company Law , the Rules of Listed Companies' General Meeting of Shareholders , the Articles of Association , the Rules of Procedure of the General Meeting of Shareholders , and other laws and regulations. The Company ensured that all shareholders enjoyed equal status, fully exercised their rights, and hired lawyers to witness and guarantee the legality of the convening, holding, and voting procedures of the meetings, safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the Company and its shareholders.

## 2. Relationship between the Controlling Shareholder and the Company

The  Company's  controlling  shareholder  is  Shenzhen  Huifengyuan  Investment  Co.,  Ltd.,  which, together  with  its  concerted  parties,  holds  a  total  of  8.7857%  of  the  Company's  shares.  The controlling shareholder exercises its rights as a shareholder legally through the General Meeting of Shareholders and does not directly or indirectly interfere with the Company's decision-making and operating activities beyond the scope of the General Meeting of Shareholders. The Company has not  engaged  in  any  irregular  behavior  of  providing  undisclosed  information  to  the  controlling shareholder.

## 3. Directors and the Board of Directors

In March 2022, the Company successfully completed the election of the new Board of Directors, with six members, including two independent directors. The number and composition of the Board of Directors comply with the requirements of laws, regulations, and the Articles of Association . All directors of the Company can carry out their work according to the Rules of Independent Directors of  Listed  Companies ,  the Rules  of  Procedure  of  the  Board  of  Directors ,  the Working  Policy  of Independent Directors , and other laws and regulations. They attend the Board of Directors meetings conscientiously, actively participate in training, and familiarize themselves with relevant laws and

regulations. Independent directors can perform their duties independently without being influenced. As of the end of the Reporting Period, the Company's Board of Directors has set up the following five  specialized  committees:  Strategy  Committee,  Audit  Committee,  Nomination  Committee, Compensation  and Appraisal Committee, and Information Disclosure Committee, and has formulated the rules of procedure for each committee. For work matters related to the committees, the relevant resolutions are submitted to the Board of Directors for deliberation after the committees have discussed them and formed opinions.

## 4. Supervisors and the Board of Supervisors

In March 2022, the Company successfully completed the election of the new Board of Supervisors, with  five  members.  The  number  and  composition  of  the  Board  of  Supervisors  comply  with  the requirements  of  laws  and  regulations.  The  Company's  Board  of  Supervisors  conscientiously performs  its  duties  according  to  the Articles  of  Association ,  the Rules  of  Procedure  of  the Supervisory Board , and other laws and regulations. It convenes the Supervisory Board according to the  specified  procedures,  supervises  the  legality  and  compliance  of  the  Company's  significant matters,  financial  conditions,  and  the  performance  of  duties  of  directors  and  senior  management personnel, and safeguards the legitimate rights and interests of the Company and its shareholders.

## 5. Stakeholders

The  Company  fully  respects  and  safeguards  the  legitimate  rights  and  interests  of  stakeholders, achieves  a  coordinated  balance  of  interests  among  society,  shareholders,  the  Company,  and employees,  treats  suppliers  and  customers  with  integrity,  earnestly  cultivates  every  employee, adheres  to  the  principle  of  mutual  benefit  and  win-win  with  relevant  stakeholders,  and  jointly promotes the Company's continuous, healthy, and rapid development.

## 6. Information disclosure and transparency

The  Company has formulated  relevant  systems  such  as  the Information  Disclosure  Management Measures ,  the Major Matters Internal Reporting System ,  the Responsibility Accountability System for  Significant  Errors  in  Annual  Report  Information  Disclosure ,  and  the Investor  Relations Management Measures .  In  strict  accordance  with  the  requirements  of  relevant  laws,  regulations, and company systems, the Company discloses information truthfully, accurately, completely, and promptly to ensure that all shareholders have equal access to information. The Company has set up a  hotline  and  a  dedicated  email  inbox  for  receiving  inquiries  from  investors,  and  it  takes  all inquiries  seriously.  The  Company's  Board  of  Directors'  Secretary  is  responsible  for  information disclosure  work,  and  the  securities  affairs  representative  assists  the  Secretary  in  carrying  out  the work.  The  Company  has  designated China  Securities  Journal , Securities  Times , Shanghai Securities News , Securities Daily , and the cninfo website (http://www.cninfo.com.cn) as the media for  public  disclosure  of  information,  enabling  investors  to  conveniently  and  promptly  access information.

Whether  the  actual  situation  of  corporate  governance  significantly  deviates  from  the  laws, administrative regulations and regulations issued by the CSRC on listed company governance.

The  actual  situation  of  corporate  governance  does  not  significantly  deviate  from  the  laws, administrative regulations and regulations issued by the CSRC on listed company governance.

## II. Independence of the Company from the Controlling Shareholder and Actual Controller in Terms of Assets, Personnel, Finance, Structure and Business

The controlling shareholder of the Company is Shenzhen Huifengyuan Investment Co., Ltd., with the actual controllers being Xu Kaihua and Wang Min couple. In addition to holding shares in the Company, the controlling shareholder Huifengyuan also holds a 15% stake in Shenzhen Qianhai Silk  Road  Industrial  Investment  Co.,  Ltd.  Apart  from  Huifengyuan,  the  actual  controllers  Xu Kaihua and Wang Min couple do not control any other companies. Mr. Xu Kaihua is the largest shareholder  of  Fengcheng  Xinyuanxing  New  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.  Xinyuanxing,  besides  holding shares in the Company, does not hold any shares or interests in any other enterprises, companies, or other institutions and organizations. The Company is independent from the controlling shareholders and the actual controllers in terms of assets, personnel, finance, institutions, and business. It has an independent and complete R&amp;D, supply, production, sales, and other business systems, and is fully capable of operating independently in the market.

## 1. Asset independence

When the Company was established, the shareholders made full contributions, which were verified by the Shenzhen Pengcheng Accounting Firm Co., Ltd. in the Shenzhen Pengcheng [2006] No. 113 Capital  Verification  Report .  The  Company  and  its  subsidiaries  possess  production  systems, auxiliary  production  systems,  and  supporting  facilities  related  to  production  and  operation.  They legally own machinery equipment, trademarks, patents, and non-patent technologies. The existing main production and operation plants are self-built, with independent raw material procurement and product sales systems. The assets and property rights of the Company and its subsidiaries are clear, without any occupation by controlling shareholders and other enterprises controlled by them. No guarantees have been provided to shareholders and their connected parties.

## 2. Personnel independence

Senior management personnel such as the General Manager, Deputy General Manager, Financial Officer, and Board Secretary work full-time at the Company and receive remuneration. They do not hold any positions and receive salaries in the shareholder entities and other enterprises controlled by them, except for being directors and supervisors. They do not hold positions in enterprises with the same  or  similar  business  as  the  Company  or  where  other  conflicts  of  interest  may  exist.  The Company's  financial  personnel  do  not  hold  part-time  positions  in  shareholder  entities  and  other enterprises controlled by them. Mr. Xu Kaihua, the actual controller of the Company, serves as the Chairman  of  the  Board.  In  participating  in  the  Company's  decision-making  and  management process, he exercises his powers in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Company Law and the Company's Articles of Association based on his different identities within the Company.

## 3. Institutional independence

The Company's operating premises and office facilities are completely separate from shareholders, with  no  mixed  operations  or  joint  offices  with  shareholders  and  associated  enterprises.  The Company  has established functional departments such as the Finance Department, Audit Department,  Production  Department,  R&amp;D  Department,  Marketing  Department,  Raw  Material Department, and Securities Department according to its operational needs. It has formulated a series of complete rules and regulations, clearly divided the work among various departments, and each department exercises its functions in accordance with the rules and regulations.

## 4. Financial independence

The  Company has established  an  independent  financial  department  and  developed  the Financial Management Policy based on current accounting standards and related laws and regulations, as well

as  the  actual  situation  of  the  Company.  It  has  established  an  independent  and  complete  financial accounting system, capable of making independent financial decisions, with standardized financial accounting and financial management systems. The Company has the necessary financial personnel. The Company has independently opened bank accounts, pays taxes independently according to law, and  there  is  no  interference  from  controlling  shareholders  and  actual  controllers  in  the  use  of company funds.

## 5. Business independence

The Company has an independent and complete R&amp;D, supply, production, sales, and other business systems,  fully  capable  of  operating  independently  in  the  market.  There  is  no  reliance  on shareholders for business operations, and there is no situation of competition or obviously unfair related party transactions between the Company and the controlling shareholders, actual controllers, and other enterprises controlled by them.

## 2. Current positions

The professional backgrounds, main work experience, and current primary responsibilities of the Company's existing directors, supervisors, and Senior Management members

In  view  of  the  expiration  of  the  term  of  office  of  the  Fifth  Board  of  Directors  and  Board  of Supervisors,  the  Company  held  the  40th  meeting  of  the  Fifth  Board  of  Directors  and  the  27th meeting of the Fifth Board of Supervisors on February 16, 2022. The meetings agreed to nominate Mr.  Xu  Kaihua,  Ms.  Wang  Min,  Mr.  Zhou  Bo,  and  Ms.  Wei  Wei  as  non-independent  director candidates  for  the  Sixth  Board  of  Directors,  and  Mr.  Pan  Feng  and  Mr.  Liu  Zhonghua  as independent  director  candidates  for  the  Sixth  Board  of  Directors.  Mr.  Song  Wanxiang,  Mr.  Wu Guangyuan,  and  Mr.  Chen  Binzhang  were  nominated  as  shareholder  representative  supervisor

candidates  for  the  Sixth  Board  of  Supervisors.  Then,  on  March  11,  the  Company  held  its  First Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders in 2022 which reviewed and approved the election of Mr. Xu Kaihua, Ms. Wang Min, Mr. Zhou Bo and Ms. Wei Wei as non-independent directors of the Sixth Board of Directors of the Company, Mr. Pan Feng and Mr. Liu Zhonghua as independent directors  of  the  Sixth  Board  of  Directors  of  the  Company,  and  Mr.  Song  Wanxiang,  Mr.  Wu Guangyuan and Mr. Chen Binzhang who are shareholders' representatives to serve as supervisors of the Company's Sixth Board of Supervisors. The first staff congress of the Company in 2022 was held on March 11. It reviewed and approved the election of Mr. Lu Xijin and Ms. Wang Jian as employee representative supervisors  of  the  Sixth  Board  of  Supervisors  of  the  Company.  Finally, members  of  the  Company's  Sixth  Board  of  Directors  are:  non-independent  directors,  Mr.  Xu Kaihua, Ms. Wang Min, Mr. Zhou Bo and Ms. Wei Wei, and independent directors, Mr. Pan Feng and Mr. Liu Zhonghua. Members of the Sixth Board of Supervisors of the Company are: Mr. Lu Xijin,  Mr.  Song  Wanxiang,  Ms.  Wang  Jian,  Mr.  Chen  Binzhang  and  Mr.  Wu  Guangyuan.  On March 18, 2022, the second meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors was held, agreeing to appoint Mr.  Xu  Kaihua  as  the  general  manager  of  the  Company,  Mr.  Zhou  Bo  as  the  executive  deputy general manager of the Company, Ms. Zhang Xiang, Mr. Zhang Yuping, Mr. Zhang Kun, Mr. Jiang Miao, Mr. Lou Huiyou, Mr. Zhang Aiqing, Mr. Pan Hua, Mr. Wang Qiang, Mr. Jiao Hua, Mr. Tang Zhou and Ms. Zhang Wei as the deputy general managers of the Company, and Mr. Mu Menggang as the deputy general manager and chief financial officer of the Company. At the same time, Mr. Mu Menggang, the Deputy  General  Manager  and  Chief  Financial  Officer  of  the  Company,  was appointed to temporarily perform the duties of the Board Secretary, with the temporary period not exceeding  three  months  from  the  date  of  approval  by  the  second  meeting  of  the  Sixth  Board  of Directors. On August 24, 2022, the Company held the 10th meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and agreed to appoint Mr. Pan Hua as the Secretary of the Board of Directors. On April 20, 2023, Mr. Zhang Aiqing resigned from his position as Deputy General Manager for personal reasons. The work  experience  of  the  current  directors,  supervisors,  and  senior  management  personnel  are  as follows:

## i. The primary work experience of directors

Xu Kaihua is of Han nationality and was born in February 1966. He is a member of the Communist Party, holds a postgraduate degree in Metallurgical Materials from Central South University, and is a  part-time  professor  at  both  Central  South  University  and  Bandung  Institute  of  Technology  in Indonesia. Moreover, he is the founder of a company. He has worked in teaching and research at Central South University and conducted short-term collaborative research at Yamamoto Laboratory, the University of Tokyo (as a hired senior researcher). He is currently the Chairman and General Manager of the Company, Vice President of the China Association of Circular Economy, Executive Director  of  Fengcheng  Xinyuanxing  New  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.,  and  Supervisor  of  Shenzhen Huifengyuan  Investment  Co.,  Ltd.  Mr.  Xu  Kaihua  holds  a  60%  equity  interest  in  Shenzhen Huifengyuan Investment Co., Ltd., a shareholder of the Company, and a 31.465% equity interest in Fengcheng  Xinyuanxing  New  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.,  another  shareholder  of  the  Company.  At  the same time, Mr. Xu Kaihua directly holds 6,805,380 shares of the Company. Mr. Xu Kaihua and Ms. Wang  Min,  a  director  of  the  Company,  are  a  married  couple  and  the  actual  controllers  of  the Company.

Wang Min, born in January 1959, is of Han ethnicity and a member of the Communist Party of China. She works as an accountant and is one of the founders of the Company. She has successively held  positions  at  Anhui  Ma  Steel  Medium  Plate  Factory,  a  subsidiary  of  CHINA  VANKE  CO., LTD., a subsidiary of Shenzhen Zhongwu Group, and Shenzhen Nonfemet HI-POWER BATTERY Material Co., Ltd. Wang Min has served as a director and executive deputy general manager of the Company, and is currently a director and executive director of Shenzhen Huifengyuan Investment

Co.,  Ltd.  Ms.  Wang  Min  holds  a  40%  equity  interest  in  the  Company's  shareholder  Shenzhen Huifengyuan  Investment  Co.,  Ltd.,  a  1.9162%  equity  interest  in  the  Company's  shareholder Fengcheng  Xinyuanxing  New  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.,  and  directly  holds  8,457,155  shares  of  the Company. She is married to Xu Kaihua, the Company's chairman, and together they are the actual controllers of the Company. She is also the sister of the Company's supervisor, Ms. Wang Jian.

Zhou Bo, of Han ethnicity, was born in July 1968. He graduated from Renmin University of China's MBA training  program  and  works  as  an  engineer.  He  has  held  successive  positions  at  Baosteel Group Chaoyang Precision Strip Steel Co., Ltd. and Shenzhen Nonfemet HI-POWER BATTERY Material Co., Ltd. Zhou Bo has served as the Company's deputy general manager, chairman of the Board  of  Supervisors,  and  is  currently  a  director  and  executive  deputy  general  manager  of  the Company. Mr. Zhou Bo holds 1,739,000 shares of the Company and has no related relationship with the Company's directors, supervisors, senior management, and shareholders holding more than 5% of the Company's shares, and actual controllers.

Wei Wei is of Han ethnicity and was born in February 1983. She has a postgraduate degree in civil and  commercial  law  from  Renmin  University  of  China.  She  has  successively  held  positions  at CITIC Securities Co., Ltd., UCF INVESTMENT Fund Management Co., Ltd., Z-Park Fund, and Chaowei Mingzhi (Hengqin) Investment Management Co., Ltd. She is currently a director of the Company and deputy general manager of Beijing Jingneng Tongxin Investment Management Co., Ltd. Ms. Wei Wei does not hold shares of the Company and has no related relationship with the Company's directors, supervisors, senior management, and shareholders holding more than 5% of the Company's shares, and actual controllers.

Pan Feng is of Han ethnicity and was born in August 1963. He is a member of the Communist Party of China and holds a doctoral degree, having graduated from Tsinghua University with a major in Materials Physics. He has worked at the Beijing Institute of Aerial Materials. Since July 1996, he has  been  a  professor  and  doctoral  supervisor  at  the  School  of  Materials  Science,  Tsinghua University. He is currently an independent director of the Company, TDG Holding Co.,Ltd., a nonindependent director of  Chongyi Zhangyuan Tungsten Industry Co., Ltd. Mr. Pan Feng does not hold  shares  of  the  Company  and  has  no  related  relationship  with  the  Company's  directors, supervisors, senior management, and shareholders holding more than 5% of the Company's shares, and actual controllers.

Liu Zhonghua, male, Han ethnicity, born in July 1965, a member of the Communist Party of China, has a postgraduate degree and is a professor of accounting. He has successively held positions at the Accounting  Department  of  Lanzhou  University  of  Finance  and  Economics  and  the  School  of Management of Guangdong University of Foreign Studies. He is currently a professor at the School of Accounting of Guangdong University of Foreign Studies, a master's supervisor, a member of the Accounting  Teaching  Steering  Committee  of  the  Ministry  of  Education,  a  director  of  the Accounting  Society  of  China  (ASC),  a  vice  president  of  the  Accounting  Society  For  Foreign Economic Relations &amp; Trade of China, an executive vice president of the Guangdong Association of  Management Accountants, an executive director of the Accounting Society of Guangdong, an executive director of the Guangdong Audit Association. He is currently an independent director of the  Company,  an  independent  director  of  Guangdong  Provincial  Expressway  Development  Co., Ltd.,  an  independent  director  of  SGIS  Songshan  Co.,  Ltd.,  an  independent  director  of  Shenzhen Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd., and an independent director of Guangzhou Yuexiu Capital Holdings  Group  Co.,  Ltd..  Mr.  Liu  Zhonghua  does  not  hold  shares  of  the  Company  and  has  no related relationship with the Company's directors, supervisors, senior management, and shareholders holding more than 5% of the Company's shares, and actual controllers.

ii. The primary work experience of Supervisors

Lu Xijin, born in September 1971, is of Han ethnicity and a member of the Communist Party. He graduated from the Applied Chemistry program at Central China Normal University and holds an MBA from  Wuhan  University,  as  well  as  a  Master's  degree.  Additionally,  he  has  obtained  the National Senior Professional Manager Certificate. Previously, he was employed at Hubei Jinggong Cement Co., Ltd. Joined GEM in 2009, successively served as Deputy General Manager of Jingmen GEM New Materials Co., Ltd., General Manager of Jiangxi GEM Resource Recycling Co., Ltd., General  Manager  of  GEM  (Wuhan)  Urban  Mining  Industry  Group  Co.,  Ltd.,  Deputy  General Manager of the Company, currently serving as Chairman of the Board of Supervisors and Employee Supervisor. Mr. Lu Xijin holds 244,000 shares of the Company's stock and has no affiliation with the Company's directors, supervisors, senior management, shareholders holding more than 5% of the Company's shares, and actual controllers.

Wang  Jian  is  of  Han  ethnicity,  born  in  June  1963.  She  holds  a  university  degree  in  Industrial Electrical Automation and is an economist. She has worked consecutively at Maanshan Iron &amp; Steel Company and  CHANGSHA LYRUN MATERIAL CO., LTD. She held a series of positions  at Jingmen  GEM  New  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.,  including  Executive  Deputy  General  Manager,  General Manager  of  Wuhan  Hannengtong  New  Energy  Automobile  Service  Co.,  Ltd.,  and  Employee Supervisor. She currently continues to serve as an Employee Supervisor at the same company. ## 3. Remuneration of directors, supervisors, and senior management personnel

Decision-making  process,  determining  basis,  and  actual  payment  of  remuneration  for  directors, supervisors, and senior management personnel

Decision-making  process:  The  remuneration  and  payment  for  directors  and  supervisors  are determined  by  the  general  meeting  of  shareholders.  Directors  and  supervisors  holding  specific positions in the Company receive remuneration based on the Company's relevant salary system and their  specific  duties.  The  annual  salary  of  senior  management  personnel  is  determined  by  the Company's Compensation and Appraisal Committee based on their annual performance.

Determining basis: The Company determines the remuneration of directors, supervisors, and senior management  personnel  according  to  the Articles  of  Association and Remuneration  Management System and other regulations.

Payment arrangement: Monthly payment in accordance with the applicable system.

## 2. Remuneration policy

## (1) Remuneration system for fresh graduates

GEM provides  fresh  graduates  with  a  remuneration  that  is  competitive  in  the  industry  and  the corresponding  regions  where  they  are  located  and  allows  remuneration  negotiation  for  each competent  and  outstanding  fresh  graduate.  Besides  the  basic  monthly  salary,  allowances  will  be granted to front-line employees engaged in production-related areas, such as production, innovation, quality,  analysis,  infrastructure  construction,  energy,  engineering,  environment  protection  and safety.  Specifically,  the  monthly  allowance  for  front-line  employees  with  a  bachelor's  degree  is RMB2,000 and that for those with a master's degree is RMB3,000. Fresh graduates will be given 08 monthly bonuses according to their levels in the annual comprehensive appraisal, and have the opportunity  to  receive  incentive  shares  and  the  three-level  talent  allowance  from  the  Company according to their comprehensive performance.

## (2) Employee benefits

GEM promotes employees' sense of gain and well-being by providing them remuneration in various forms. After employee admission, the Company will provide a diversity of employee benefits such as "five social insurances and one housing fund", dormitories of different types, employee activity center,  functional  areas  (basketball  courts,  badminton  courts,  fitness  rooms,  libraries,  etc.),  free shuttle bus service, holiday benefits, birthday gifts, length-of-service-based allowances, free health examinations and employee training. In order to solidly implement measures for employee care, the Company has formulated a series of policies on health protection and occupational health for frontline  employees  and  set  up  sites  and  facilities  for  health  protection  and  occupational  health  in workshops, living space and offices, so as to prevent occupational diseases and viral infection. The Company provides opportunities to work abroad and will take actions to care for employees who work abroad. The headquarters and the Company's industrial parks will visit and show care for the families of their employees working abroad, so as to mitigate the worries of these employees that they leave at home and effectively improve their sense of well-being and satisfaction.

## (3) Talent housing

GEM always attaches great importance to the development of its talent team. In order to stabilize its talent team, ensure the sustainable talent development, and effectively serve talent from the spiritual perspective  and  the  perspective  of  logistics  support,  the  Group  has  allocated  apartments  varying from 110 to 160 square meters to leading/innovative talents, senior/foreign experts, post-doctoral employees, directors, supervisors, and other senior managers in Jingmen. The Company allocates apartments to senior talents to effectively ensure content housing and working of employees, create a worry-free living and working environment, promote employees' sense of belonging, and achieve the joint development and progress of employees and the Company.

## 3. Training Plan

## (1) Orientation training

All  new  employees  must  participate  in  orientation  training  to  understand  and  learn  about  the Company's  profile,  rules  and  regulations,  product  knowledge,  relevant  laws  and  regulations,  the awareness of safety and quality, confidentiality provisions, etc. For new employees in specific posts, the  corresponding  functional  departments  shall  organize  them  to  complete  special  skill  training during the probationary period, so that they can meet the requirements of the corresponding posts as soon as possible. Moreover, the departments responsible for the training shall make corresponding training records and conduct corresponding post-training appraisal.

## (2) Elite training classes

From July 5 to August 26, 2022, 233 new graduate employees participated in the two-month-long 2022 Elite Training Class. The training content include course lectures, learning through industrial park visits, outdoor training, competitions in various forms, workshop internships, and achievement reports.  From  the  "Urban  Mines"  Museum  in  the  Jingmen  Industrial  Park,  through  the  aesthetic Waste Art Theme Park in the Wuhan Industrial Park and the world's first Cobalt Theme Industrial Museum  in  the  Taixing  Industrial  Park,  to  the  industry-leading  Renewable  Resource  Recycling Production  Line  in  the  Jiangxi  Industrial  Park,  various  featured  locations  in  the  Company's industrial parks have not only surprised these new employees with the park-style environment of the  industrial  parks  but  also  provided  them  more  in-depth  insights  into  the  Company's  business. After  the  training  class,  they  will  undoubtedly  perform  their  duties  more  passionately,  fulfill themselves  more  diligently,  and  grow  into  a  new  force  to  support  the  green  and  low-carbon development of GEM.

## (3) GEM - Tsinghua University Leadership Training Class for the New Era

In order to comprehensively implement the talent spirit of "investing in talent, fulfilling the dream of  talent,  and  jointly  creating  a  low-carbon  future!",  solidly  promote  the  implementation  of  the Group's  three  "one-thousand"  talent  training  programs  between  2021  and  2025,  and  build  an "international, professional and performance-oriented" team to facilitate GEM's vision of becoming a  Global  500  enterprise,  GEM  joins  hands  with  Tsinghua  University  to  convene  the  GEM  Tsinghua University Leadership Training Class for the New Era based on the premium-class faculty. In  August 2022, a total  of 68 employees attended the first training class. The youngest being 26 years old, the trainees had an average age of 36 years old, as most of them were born in 1980s. Moreover, nearly two thirds of them have a doctor's or master's degree.

## (4) Safety training

The Company has established an all-round and multi-level safety training system that covers leaders at  all  levels,  managers  and  operators,  and  has  strictly  stipulated  the  minimum  number  of  safety training sessions. The main content of safety training for leaders at all levels is the implementation of relevant laws and regulations, the enhancement of the awareness of safety and the broadening of safety knowledge. The main content of safety training for managers is the enhancement of the sense of duty, the mastery of safety management methods and the strengthening of safety skills. The main content  of  safety  training  for  operators  is  the  enhancement  of  the  awareness  of  safety  and  the strengthening of the abilities of risk identification, safe operations, emergency response, self aid and mutual aid. Meanwhile, safety information sharing and notification are carried out in various forms, such  as  meetings,  online  measures,  briefings,  and  team  meetings,  to  improve  the  quality  and efficiency of safety training. In 2022, a total of 120 safety training sessions were conducted in all industrial parks of GEM, attracting approximately 10,000 participants.

## X. Profit Distribution and Conversion of Capital Reserve into Share Capital of the Company

Formulation,  execution  and  adjustments  of  the  profit  distribution  policies,  especially  the  cash dividend distribution policy, during the Reporting Period

##  Applicable □Not applicable

In accordance with the provisions of relevant laws, regulations and normative documents, such as the Notice on Further Implementation of Issues in relation to Cash Dividend Distribution of Listed Companies (ZH.J.F. [2012] No.37) and the Notice on Conscientious Implementation of the Relevant Requirements  of  the  Notice  on  Further  Implementation  of  Issues  in  relation  to  Cash  Dividend Distribution of Listed Companies (SH.ZH.J.G.S.Z. [2012] No.43), as well as the relevant provisions of  the Articles  of  Association ,  and  in  combination  with  the  real  situation  of  the  Company,  the Company formulated the Shareholder Return Plan for the Next Three Years (2019-2021) ,  which passed  deliberation  at  the  Company's  2018  annual  general  meeting.  It  is  stipulated  in  the Shareholder Return Plan for the Next Three Years (2019-2021) that  the  Company,  in  the  future three years, "if the premise for cash dividend distribution is satisfied and there are no arrangements for major capital expenditures, shall ensure that the annual profit distributed in cash is not less than 15% of the profit distributable to shareholders of the year, and the accumulated profit distributed in cash in the recent three years is not less than 45% of the average annual distributable profit obtained in  the  corresponding  period",  thereby  providing  a  policy-based  guarantee  for  the  continuity  and stability  of  the  Company's  profit  distribution  policies  to  adequately  protect  the  legal  rights  and interests of small- and medium-sized investors.

During  the  Reporting  Period,  the  Company  implemented  and  completed  the  2021  Equity Distribution Plan: To distribute a cash dividend of RMB0.29 (tax-inclusive) per 10 shares and zero bonus shares (tax-inclusive) to each shareholder based on the total share capital of 4,783,522,257 shares,  without  conversion  of  capital  reserves  into  the  share  capital.  The  implementation  of  the equity distribution plan completed on June 17, 2022.

To take into account the interests of minority shareholders and allow all shareholders to share the operating results, the 15th meeting of the 6th Board of Directors of the Company reviewed and approved the distribution plan -- distributing a cash dividend of RMB0.5 (tax-inclusive) per 10 shares and 0 bonus shares (tax-inclusive) to all shareholders based on the total share capital of 5,135,586,557 shares, with no capitalization from the public reserve. If the total share capital of the Company changes due to factors such as share repurchases and the exercise of rights regarding equity incentives, the Company plans to adjust the total amount of distribution based on the total share capital on the equity registration date when the distribution plan is implemented in the future in accordance with the principle of a fixed distribution ratio. The above profit distribution plan matches the growth of the Company's performance and is legal, compliant and reasonable.

## 1. Equity incentive

On May 17, 2022, the Company held the Fifth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors to deliberate on and approve the proposals related to the share incentive plan, including the Proposal on the 2022 Restricted  Share  Incentive  Plan  (Draft)  and  Its  Summary ,  the Proposal  on  the  Management Measures for the Assessment of the Implementation of the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan , and the Proposal on Requesting the General Meeting of Shareholders to Authorize the Company's Board of Directors to Handle Matters Related to the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan . On the same day, the Company's independent directors issued independent opinions on the Proposal on the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan (Draft) and Its Summary and related matters.

On May 17, 2022,  the  Company  held  the  Fourth  Meeting  of  the  Sixth  Board  of  Supervisors  to deliberate on and approve the Proposal on the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan (Draft) and Its Summary , the Proposal on the Management Measures for the Assessment of the Implementation of the  2022  Restricted  Share  Incentive  Plan ,  and  the Proposal  on  Verifying  the  List  of  Incentive Objects of the Company's 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan .

From May 18, 2022 to May 27, 2022, the Company internally announced the list and positions of the proposed incentive objects. As at the expiration of the publicity period, the Company's Board of Supervisors  has  not  received  any  objection  on  the  list  and  positions  of  the  incentive  objects announced. On May 31, 2022, the Company disclosed the Explanations of the Board of Supervisors for the Review Opinions on the List of Partial Incentive Objects Granted for the First Time in the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan and the Publicity . The Company's Board of Supervisors held that  the  incentive  objects  included  in  the  incentive  plan  meet  the  conditions  stipulated  in  the relevant laws, regulations and normative documents, and are legal and valid as the incentive objects of the restricted share incentive plan.

On June 6, 2022, the Company held the Third Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders in 2022 to deliberate on and approve the proposals related to the share incentive plan, including the Proposal on the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan (Draft) and Its Summary , the Proposal on the Management  Measures  for  the  Assessment  of  the  Implementation  of  the  2022  Restricted  Share Incentive Plan , and the Proposal on Requesting the General Meeting of Shareholders to Authorize the  Company's  Board  of  Directors  to  Handle  Matters  Related  to  the  2022  Restricted  Share Incentive Plan .  The Company was approved to implement the incentive plan, and the Company's Board of Directors was authorized to handle matters related to the incentive plan. Meanwhile, the Company disclosed the Self-Inspection Report on the Trading of the Company's Shares by Insiders

and Incentive Objects in the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan based on the verification of the trading of the Company's shares by insiders and incentive objects.

On July 18, 2022, the Company held the Eighth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and the Seventh Meeting of the Sixth Board of Supervisors to deliberate on and approve the Proposal on Adjusting Matters Related to the Company's 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan and the Proposal on  Granting  Restricted  Shares  for  the  First  Time  to  Incentive  Recipients .  A  total  of  42,039,300 restricted shares were determined to be granted to 677 incentive recipients at a price of RMB3.641 per share, with July 18, 2022 as the first grant date. The Board of Supervisors verified the adjusted list  of  incentive  objects.  The  independent  directors  expressed  independent  opinions  on  relevant matters, holding that the adjustment of the incentive plan complies with the relevant regulations, the qualifications of the incentive objects are legal and valid, and the determined granting date complies with the relevant regulations.

In  accordance with the Administrative Measures for Equity Incentive of Listed Companies of  the CSRC, Shenzhen Stock Exchange and provisions of relevant rules of Shenzhen Branch of China Clear,  the  Company  completed  the  registration  of  the  restricted  shares  granted  for  the  first  time under the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan. A total of 42,039,300 restricted shares were granted at a price of RMB3.641 per share, with July 28, 2022 as the date of granting and September 2, 2022 as the date of listing.

Appraisal mechanisms and incentives for senior management

The Company has established a complete performance appraisal system and a remuneration policy for senior managers. During the Reporting Period, in strict compliance with the Company Law , the Articles  of  Association and  other  relevant  laws  and  regulations  of  China,  the  Company's  senior management were able to diligently fulfill their duties, actively implement the relevant resolutions of the Company's general meetings and the Board of Directors, actively adjust business strategies under the correct guidance of the Board of Directors, continuously strengthen internal management, and achieve a fair performance in the completion of this year's tasks. The Company's appraisal and

incentive mechanisms and the relevant reward policies were effectively implemented and produced the due effect of incentive and restriction.

During the Reporting Period, the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan (Draft) of GEM Co., Ltd. and its summary were deliberated and approved at the Third Extraordinary General Meeting of the Company in 2022. It is stipulated in the scheme that a total of 42,039,300 restricted shares from ordinary  A  shares  issued  by  the  Company  to  incentive  recipients  were  granted  to  677  incentive recipients at a price of RMB3.641 per share, with July 18, 2022 as the date of granting. Among the 677  incentive  recipients,  the  13  senior  management  were  granted  a  total  of  7,700,300  restricted shares.  The  restricted  shares  under  the  incentive  plan  are  valid  for  a  period  of  no  more  than  60 months  from  the  date  of  granting  till  the  date  of  releasing  or  repurchasing  &amp;  canceling.  The restricted incentive shares granted this time was granted on July 18, 2022, and listed on September 2,  2022.  For  details,  please  refer  to  the Announcement  on  the  Completion  of  the  Granting  of Restricted  Shares  for  the  First  Time  in  2022 that  the  Company  published  on China  Securities Journal , Securities Times , Shanghai Securities News , Securities Daily and http://www.cninfo.com.cn on August 31, 2022.

## Pollutant treatment

In 2022, GEM carried out refined environmental control and governance and checked and remedied shortcomings  and  omissions  through  precise  targeting,  implementation,  and  assessment.  GEM comprehensively improved its environmental governance capacity, reduced wastewater and exhaust gas discharge,  and increased the reuse  rate of  reclaimed water. GEM  continuously improved the environment and reduced pollution and carbon emission, thus enhancing the synergy of environmental governance and achieving remarkable results in environmental governance. All new, renovation,  and  expansion  projects  in  parks  of  the  Company  in  2022  strictly  adhered  to  the simultaneous  design,  construction,  and  commissioning  of  the  pollution  control  facilities  and  the main project.

In 2022, the Company carried out in-depth treatment of wastewater and waste gas, as well as energy conservation  and  emission  reduction  work,  and  achieved  good  results.  The  recovery  rate  of ammonia nitrogen is 100%, the recovery rate of VOCs is greater than 99%, the water consumption per ton of product is reduced by 30%, the energy consumption per ton of product is reduced by 15%, and the COD value is reduced by 10%.

## Wastewater treatment:

The wastewater collection strictly  followed  the  principles  of  "separation  of  rain  and  wastewater, separation of clean water and wastewater, and separate treatment by water quality". Wastewater of different nature was treated by specific process and equipment to meet the standard and then reused for production as a priority with the remaining amount discharged.

GEM (Jingmen) recovered multiple resources for recycling and reduced emissions from the source by  stabilizing  the  operation  of  the  ammonia  recovery  and  recycling  system,  salt  recovery  and recycling  system,  and  reclaimed  water  reuse  system.  Adopting  the  combination  technology  of "steam extraction + membrane + MVR", it achieved nearly "zero" discharge of wastewater from the production of the precursor of power battery materials and increased the water reuse rate by over 60%. In addition, it expanded the production of "replacing sodium with ammonia" and the nickel deep recycling project,  which further reduced the emission on the basis of meeting the emission standard,  realized  production  increase  without  pollution  increase,  and  effectively  released  the environmental  capacity.  The  total  wastewater  discharge  outlet  was  installed  with  an  online monitoring  system,  and  the  data  was  linked  to  the  network  of  Hubei  Provincial  Department  of Ecology and Environment and Jingmen Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment to monitor the wastewater discharge in real time.

GEM (Jiangxi) Urban Mineral Resources Grand Market expanded the capacity of the wastewater treatment station and made an upgrade to enhance the system's resistance to shock and risk, which ensured the stable production and normal discharge by enterprises in the park.

The environmental protection facilities of all other branches and subsidiaries operated stably and the wastewater was discharged in accordance with the standards.

## Exhaust gas treatment:

In  2022,  all  parks  continued  to  strengthen  the  collection  and  treatment  of  exhaust  gases  so  as  to collect them as much as possible and resolutely put an end to fugitive discharge. The operation of the exhaust gas treatment facilities strictly implemented the "four" management regulations of the Group, and facilities were suspended, idled, and dismantled in strict compliance with the approval procedures.

In an in-depth campaign of exhaust gas emission reduction, GEM (Jingmen) upgraded six sets of ammonia-related exhaust gas treatment facilities (from two-stage spray washing to three-stage spray washing,  which  improved  the  efficiency  of  ammonia  removal  from  exhaust  gas  and  reduced ammonia emission) and three sets of dust-related exhaust  gas  treatment  facilities  (from  bag-type dust removal to "bag-type dust removal + water curtain dust removal", which strengthened the dust removal  efficiency  and  reduced  dust  emission)  and  fully  completed  the  upgrading  of  volatile organic  chemical  (VOC)  treatment  facilities  (from  "spray  washing"  absorption  process  to  "spray washing absorption + atomization drying + activated carbon adsorption-desorption" process, which recovered solvent oil for recycling and reduced VOC emission). By doing so, it reduced emission of various  types  of  exhaust  gas  pollutants  in  all  respects  and  through  multiple  channels,  further improving the environment of the park and the surroundings.

For  all  branches  and  subsidiaries  of  the  Group  involved  in  the  emission  of  key  pollutants,  the exhaust  gases  were  collected  effectively  and  discharged  at  a  high  altitude  after  treatment  by efficient  environmental  protection  facilities  to  meet  the  standards.  In  addition,  the  key  pollutant outlets  were  installed  with  online  monitoring  systems  for  exhaust  gases  and  were  linked  to  the network of the ecological and environmental authorities of the local government. All environmental protection  facilities  were  equipped  with  dedicated  personnel  for  management  to  achieve  24-hour real-time online monitoring of pollutants and meet the emission standards.

## Solid waste management:

All  solid  waste  warehouses  built  by  branches  and  subsidiaries  of  the  Group  implemented  the management  policy  of  "zoning,  marking,  safety,  neatness,  and  smoothness"  and  followed  the principle of "first in, first out". The Company appointed qualified units to carry out safe disposal regularly and installed video monitoring systems at storage sites for the whole-procedure visualized control  of  solid  waste.  Meanwhile,  the  separation  and  recycling,  resource  utilization,  and  safe disposal  of  waste  to  reduce  the  generation  of  solid  waste  from  the  source  were  achieved  Groupwide.

In  2022,  GEM  (Hubei)  Solid  Waste  Disposal  Co.,  Ltd.  obtained  the  hazardous  waste  operation license issued by Hubei Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment and was qualified for the collection, storage and landfill of 20 major categories and 179 minor categories of hazardous solid waste with an approved operation scale of 55,000 tons/year. The disposal center is based in Jingmen and serves northwestern Hubei Province. Equipped with the first rigid landfill  depot  of hazardous  waste  in  Hubei  Province,  it  will  contribute  to  the  development  of  Jingmen  and  even northwestern Hubei Province.

## Noise management:

In strict accordance with the self-monitoring requirements of the pollutant discharge permit, GEM, following the annual testing work plan for environmental management, appointed a qualified thirdparty monitoring company to monitor the noise in the factory and at the factory boundary of GEM. The  test  results  were  100%  within  the  standard  limits  and  in  line  with  the  noise  management standards.

## Environmental protection facilities operation and management:

The  Group  strictly implemented  the "four" principles for the operation and maintenance management of environmental protection facilities: the availability of an operational management system, persons responsible for maintenance, records of operation and maintenance management, and emergency disposal methods for abnormal facilities. The Group implemented the principle of local  management  for  the  operation  and  management  of  environmental  protection  facilities,  in which the Department of Environmental Planning and Supervision is responsible for supervision and inspection to ensure that abnormalities are corrected and dealt with in a timely manner and that environmental  protection  facilities  are  synchronized  with  the  main  facilities  and  are  operated normally, so that pollutants are discharged in a stable manner to meet the standards.

## Environmental management operation and information control:

GEM Group established the Environmental Management Control Center and adopted the "Green + Safety  +  Intelligence"  management  model.  The  center  built  a  digital  platform  for  environmental information management by integrating environmental protection cloud, online monitoring, video surveillance,  and  other  systems  and  realized  the  visualization  and  informatization  of  the  park's environmental  management.  It  acted  as  the  center  of  supervision  and  inspection,  coordination,

scheduling, and command in the Group's environmental protection operation and management and ensured the Company's green and high-quality development.

As the  first  in  China  to  adopt  the  "Internet  +  environmental  management"  model,  the  Company strictly followed the principle of local management of environmental protection offline and adopted 24-hour 360-degree video monitoring of key pollution sources online as well as real-time online upload of emission monitoring data on various pollutants. It created the environmental protection cloud system platform of GEM Group and continuous aggregated and monitored the environmental protection  operation  and  management  data  of  the  Group's  parks,  so  as  to  make  the  Group's environmental protection data collectable, analyzable and releasable. Since March 10, 2022, a total of nearly 300 Group environmental dailies have been issued, 348 online monitoring anomalies and 65  system  offline  events  have  been  tracked  and  coordinated  in  a  timely  manner,  significantly improving the Group's environmental supervision efficiency and significantly reducing the Group's environmental management risks.

## Environmental self-monitoring plans

In  accordance  with  "HJ  819-2017  General  Technical  Guidelines  for  Self-monitoring  of  Pollutant Discharge Units" and related technical requirements of monitoring, all branches and subsidiaries of the Company formulated the self-monitoring plan for 2022 and signed monitoring service contracts with qualified third-party environmental monitoring agencies. The environmental monitoring work was carried out in strict accordance with the monitoring plan, and all monitoring results fully met the standards. Meanwhile, self-monitoring of soil and groundwater for 2022 was actively conducted. In  addition,  some  parks  have  built  ambient  air  quality  monitoring  stations  and  installed  online monitoring devices for fugitive discharge at the factory boundary, which can monitor the ambient air  quality  in  and  around  the  factory  in  real  time  and  guide  production  and  environmental management.

Jingmen Park, leveraging its strengths, carried out 537 self-monitoring tasks throughout the year, further strengthening the environmental control of the park and reducing the risk of environmental management.

The  Group  further  strengthened  environmental  information  construction  and  built  a  digital environmental management information platform for 24h monitoring of key pollution sources and real-time knowledge of the environmental operation and emission compliance of all parks.

## Contingency plans for environmental emergencies

All  branches  and  subsidiaries  of  GEM  have  prepared  the  "Contingency  Plan  for  Environmental Emergencies"  according  to  the  standards,  which  passed  expert  review,  and  have  completed  the filing  work  of  the  competent  authority  of  ecological  and  environmental  protection  of  the  local government in accordance with the laws. In terms of contingency management for environmental emergencies  within  the Group,  all  branches and  subsidiaries  have formulated  and  strictly implemented contingency drill plans, which has enhanced the Group's environmental awareness and contingency  response  capability  for  environmental  emergencies.  All  branches  and  subsidiaries checked their shortcomings in environmental protection through drills and effectively reduced the environmental management risk through continuous improvement. In 2022, a total of 29 branches and  subsidiaries  of  the  Company  participated  in  the  organization  of  more  than  135  contingency drills, with a total of more than 4.900 participants.; a total of 299 environmental protection training sessions  were  conducted  throughout  the  year,  with  9,101  participants,  an  increase  of  12.35% compared with 2021, enhancing the awareness and skill of all employees and their ability to take action in environmental protection emergencies.

Input in environmental management and protection and the payment of environmental protectionrelated taxes

In  2022, GEM Group invested RMB578 million in environmental protection, of which RMB246 million was spent on the construction of environmental protection facilities for new, renovation, and expansion  projects  and  the  upgrading  and  transformation  of  some  environmental  protection facilities to reduce waste water and waste gas pollutants, increase reuse rate of waster water, and implement  the  strategy  of  "supporting  old  facilities  with  new  ones,  and  increasing  production without more pollution"; the Group invested RMB332 million in the treatment of waste water and waste  gas,  as  well  as  standardized  management  of  solid  waste,  so  as  to  ensure  the  stable  and compliant discharge of pollutants and the regulation-based environmental management.

In 2022, the Group paid RMB1,257,300 in environmental protection tax. Branches and subsidiaries of  the  Group  vigorously  pushed  ahead  with  the  upgrading  and  refinement  of  environmental protection  facilities  and  refined  their  management;  in  the  process  from  equipment  renovation, precise regulation of the front-end collection system dampers to the operation and management of final  prevention  and  control  facilities,  the  Group  ensures  that  the  environmental  governance facilities  are  always  in  a  good  operating  condition  and  that  pollutants  are  stable  and  in  low concentration to meet the requirements for standard emissions.

Measures taken to reduce carbon emissions during the Reporting Period and their effectiveness

##  Applicable □Not applicable

In 2022, GEM adhered to the path of green and circular development by proactively exploring its unique  carbon  emission  reduction  path,  and  responding  fully  to  the  national  policy  of  carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality. The Group reduced its carbon emissions through the use of clean energy, the promotion of energy-saving and emission reduction technologies and low-carbon initiatives,  and  practically  implemented  the  carbon  peaking  and  carbon  neutrality  strategy.  The measures are as follows:

1. Increased use of renewable energy. In 2022, the Group generated power of 58,163,634.8kwh by purchasing  green  power  of  63,117,040kwh  and  building  rooftop  PV  projects  in  GEM  Jingmen, Wuhan, Taixing, Xiantao Jiangxi and other parks during the Reporting Period, which have reduced carbon emissions by about 70,464 tons.

The Group employed the new permanent magnet motor to replace the ordinary energy-saving motor, increasing the energy-saving efficiency by 10%.

The Group made a series of energy-saving and emission reduction efforts by upgrading equipment and facilities, optimizing processes, etc. to cut energy use and carbon emissions. By installing air compressor  waste  heat  recyclers,  the  Group  saved  steam  and  electricity  cost  of  more  than RMB800,000 per year; by installing steam condensate recyclers, the Group saved steam of more than RMB1.2 million per year; by transforming air compressor frequency conversion, the Group saved electricity cost of more than RMB480,000 per year; by transforming non-powered air balls, the Group saved electricity cost of more than RMB720,000 per year.

The  Group  precisely  controlled  production,  arranged  for  centralized  production  of  major  powerconsuming equipment, and strictly  controlled  start-up  shifts,  which  have  improved  load  rate  and reduced unit electricity consumption.

In  2022, the Group fully carried out the construction and certification of the carbon peaking and carbon  neutrality  system.  The  establishment  of  the  carbon  emission  inventory  system  and completion  of  the  annual  carbon  inventory  made  clear  the  carbon  emission  data,  providing  data support for the establishment of the Group's carbon reduction target; the Group has completed the certification  of  Zero  Carbon  Park  (Wuhan  Park);  making  Wuhan  Park  a  zero  carbon  pilot,  the Group  aims  to  create  a  "zero  carbon  model"  benchmark  in  the  industry,  which  is  of  great significance to the Group's smooth progress towards carbon neutrality; in addition, the Group has completed  the  carbon  footprint  certification  of  three  products  to  fully  understand  the  carbon consumption in production, which facilitates the Group's low carbon management, energy saving and production cost saving. At the same time, the Group met customer expectations and improved corporate reputation. It shows the Group's commitment to respond to national policies and fulfill its social responsibility.

The Group released the Guidelines for Low Carbon Actions, advocating employees to "speak, act and consume in a low-carbon manner". The Group built up "3R" low-carbon supermarket in parks to  sell  low-carbon  products,  consign  and  exchange  second-hand  goods,  and  recycle  renewable resources, etc. The "Beautiful China Carbon Reduction Card" was issued to encourage employees to practice low-carbon consumption by exchanging carbon points for goods, and electric car/lowspeed electric  vehicle  charging  facilities  are  built  in  parks  to  encourage  employees  to  use  public transportation/subway/shared  bicycle/electric  vehicle  to  travel  green.  Low-speed  electric  vehicle charging facilities will be built to encourage employees to travel by bus, subway, shared bicycle, electric vehicle and other green means. The gradual construction of low-carbon demonstration parks has contributed to the Company's carbon emission reduction.

Through the multiple utilization of waste resources, planting trees, and green carbon reduction, the Group changed waste and green into "carbon sinks". In 2022, the Group reduced carbon emission by  over  800,000  tons  of  CO2eq  through  scrapped  car  dismantling,  multiple  utilization  of  power batteries, E-waste and waste plastic recycling, etc.; the Group also proactively responded to the goal of planting trees and reducing carbon by carrying out the activity of "planting one carbon neutrality tree and building 10,000 mu of carbon neutrality forests".

## II. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)

GEM has always been dedicated to promoting social progress and social harmony. As a socially responsible  enterprise,  the  Company  is  well  aware  of  its  mission  to  create  more  well-being  for society. In its day-to-day management, the Company always considers social responsibility as a top priority and actively conducted a number of social responsibility projects, including the Belt and Road,  Giving  Financial  Aid  to  Students  and  Assisting  the  Poor  with  Intelligence,  Assistance  in Difficulties, and Public Visit. Our efforts have achieved remarkable results, and the Company will continue  to  uphold  the  concept  of  social  responsibility  and  make  positive  contributions  to  the harmonious development of society.

## 1.  GEM  has  deeply  cultivated  in  Indonesia  the  concept  of  integration  and  development  of industry,  technology  and  culture  to  build  a  green  "Belt  and  Road",  demonstrating  the responsibility of the ESG Leading Enterprise for Green Development in China.

The Company has built the highlighted project of China-Indonesia cooperation in Indonesia, which has  created  jobs  for  more  than  2,000  local  Indonesians;  jointly  trained  two  groups  of  53 postgraduates  in  metallurgical  engineering  for  Indonesia;  built  a  world-class  nickel-resource industry museum and engineering experiment center, demonstrating the surging power to drive new energy with Indonesia's nickel resources;

During  the  earthquake  in  Cianjur,  West  Java,  Indonesia,  the  Company  timely  delivered  urgent supplies  worth  approximately USD150,000 overnight including 5,000 blankets, 1,000 mattresses, 770  cartons  of  mineral  water,  1,400  cartons  of  bread,  250  cartons  of  milks  to  help  the  disasterstricken areas in their earthquake relief efforts. On the morning of March 20, 2023, the Company, as one  of  the  invited  representatives  of  Chinese  enterprises,  was  commended  by  the  Indonesian government  and  awarded  the  PPKM  award.  ,  demonstrating  the  recognition  and  praise  of  the Indonesian government for the Company as well as the Indonesian QMB Nickel Resource Project invested  and  controlled  by  the  Company  for  fulfilling  social  responsibility,  giving  back  to  the Indonesian society, and achieving common development philosophy and good deeds.

## VI. Description of Changes in Accounting Policies and Accounting Estimates, or Corrections of Significant Accounting Errors Compared to the Previous Year's Financial Statement

##  Applicable □Not applicable

On December 30, 2021, the Ministry of Finance issued the "Notice on Issuing Interpretation No. 15 of Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises" (C.K. [2021] No. 35) (hereinafter referred to as "Document Interpretation No. 15"), which stipulated the accounting treatment of the external sales of  products  or  by-products  produced  by  enterprises  before  their  fixed  assets  reach  the  intended usable state or during the research and development process, the related presentation on centralized management of funds, and the judgment on onerous contracts.

The contents in Interpretation No. 15, "accounting treatment of the external sales of products or byproducts produced by enterprises before their fixed assets reach the intended usable state or during the research and development process" and "judgment on onerous contracts", were implemented as of  January  1,  2022.  For  details,  see  the  related  announcement  disclosed  by  the  Company  on http://www.cninfo.com.cn on April 28, 2022.

On November 30, 2022, the Ministry of Finance issued the "Notice on Issuing the Interpretation No. 16 of the Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises" (C.K. [2022] No. 31) (hereinafter referred to  as  "Document Interpretation No. 16"), which stipulated the "accounting treatment for deferred income tax relating to assets and liabilities arising from a single transaction that is not subject to the initial  recognition  exemption",  "accounting  treatment  of  the  income  tax  effect  of  financial instrument-related dividend  classified by  the issuer  as  equity  instrument",  and  "accounting treatment of share-based payment in cash settlement modified into share-based payment in equity settlement by the enterprise".

"Accounting treatment for deferred income tax relating to assets and liabilities arising from a single transaction that is not subject to the initial recognition exemption" in Document Interpretation 16 came  into  force  as  of  January  1,  2023,  and  "accounting  treatment  of  the  income  tax  effect  of financial instrument-related dividend classified by the issuer as equity instrument" and "accounting treatment of share-based payment in cash settlement modified into share-based payment in equity settlement by the enterprise" took effect as of the date of declaration.

## VII.  Description  of  Changes  in  the  Scope  of  Consolidated  Statements  Compared  to  the Previous Year's Financial Statement

##  Applicable □Not applicable

1.  In  January 2022, the subsidiary GEM (Jingmen) Nickel-Cobalt Materials Co., Ltd. established Jingmen Huineng Labor Service Co., Ltd., with a registered capital of RMB500,000, holding 100% of  the  shares.  The  new  company  was  included  in  the  consolidation  scope  during  this  Reporting Period.

2. In April 2022, the subsidiary GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt Industry Co., Ltd. acquired Taixing Xinxin Resource Recycling Co., Ltd. through the non-business equity acquisition. The new company has registered capital was RMB26,062,778, and GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt Industry Co., Ltd. holds 100% of  its  shares.  The  new  company  was  included  in  the  consolidation  scope  during  this  Reporting Period.

3.  In  October  2022,  the  subsidiary  Fuan  Qingmei  Energy  Materials  Co.,  Ltd.  established  Ningde Qingmei Trade Co., Ltd. with a registered capital of RMB10 million, holding 60% of the shares. The new company was included in the consolidation scope during this Reporting Period.
4.  In  December  2022,  the  Company  established  GEM  (Shenzhen)  Super  Green  Technology Research Center Co., Ltd. with a registered capital of RMB55 million, holding 100% of the shares. The new company was included in the consolidation scope during this Reporting Period.
5.  In  November 2022, the Company deregistered the subsidiary Fengcheng Meisheng Renewable Resources  Co.,  Ltd.  The  business  information  changes  were  completed  on  November  10,  2022, upon which the subsidiary would not be included in the consolidation scope.

## XVI. Notes on Other Significant Events

##  Applicable □Not applicable

Given that the terms of office of the Fifth Board of Directors and the Fifth Board of Supervisors had expired, the Company held the Fortieth Meeting of the Fifth Board of Directors and the Twentyseventh Meeting of the Fifth Board of Supervisors on February 16, 2022. At the two meetings, the Company agreed to nominate Mr. Xu Kaihua, Ms. Wang Min, Mr. Zhou Bo, and Ms. Wei Wei as candidates for non-independent directors of the Company's Sixth Board of Directors, and Mr. Pan Feng and Mr. Liu Zhonghua as candidates for independent directors of the Company's Sixth Board of  Directors.  Besides,  Mr.  Song  Wanxiang,  Mr.  Wu  Guangyuan,  and  Mr.  Chen  Binzhang  were nominated as shareholders' representatives to serve as supervisors of the Company's Sixth Board of Supervisors.    Then,  on  March  11,  the  Company  held  its  First  Extraordinary  General  Meeting  of Shareholders in 2022 which reviewed and approved the election of Mr. Xu Kaihua, Ms. Wang Min, Mr. Zhou Bo and Ms. Wei Wei as non-independent directors of the Sixth Board of Directors of the Company, Mr. Pan Feng and Mr. Liu Zhonghua as independent directors of the Sixth  Board of Directors of the Company, and Mr. Song Wanxiang, Mr. Wu Guangyuan and Mr. Chen Binzhang who  are  shareholders'  representatives  to  serve  as  supervisors  of  the  Company's  Sixth  Board  of Supervisors. The first staff congress of the Company in 2022 was held on March 11. It reviewed and  approved  the  election  of  Mr.  Lu  Xijin  and  Ms.  Wang  Jian  as  employee  representative supervisors of the Sixth Board of Supervisors of the Company. Finally, members of the Company's Sixth Board of Directors are: non-independent directors, Mr. Xu Kaihua, Ms. Wang Min, Mr. Zhou Bo and Ms. Wei Wei, and independent directors, Mr. Pan Feng and Mr. Liu Zhonghua. Members of the Sixth Board of Supervisors of the Company are: Mr. Lu Xijin, Mr. Song Wanxiang, Ms. Wang Jian, Mr. Chen Binzhang and Mr. Wu Guangyuan. On March 18, 2022, the second meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors was held, agreeing to appoint Mr. Xu Kaihua as the general manager of the Company, Mr. Zhou Bo as the executive deputy general manager of the Company, Ms. Zhang Xiang, Mr. Zhang Yuping, Mr. Zhang Kun, Mr. Jiang Miao, Mr. Lou Huiyou, Mr. Zhang Aiqing, Mr. Pan Hua, Mr. Wang Qiang, Mr. Jiao Hua, Mr. Tang Zhou and Ms. Zhang Wei as the deputy general managers of the Company, and Mr. Mu Menggang as the deputy general manager and chief financial officer of the Company. On August 24, 2022, the Company held the 10th meeting of the Sixth  Board  of  Directors  and  agreed  to  appoint  Mr.  Pan  Hua  as  the  Secretary  of  the  Board  of Directors.  On  April  20,  2023,  Mr.  Zhang  Aiqing  resigned  from  his  position  as  Deputy  General Manager for personal reasons.

The Company convened the Fourth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and the Third Meeting of  the  Sixth  Board  of  Supervisors  on  April  28,  2022,  and  the  Second  Extraordinary  General Meeting of 2022 on May 16, 2022, at which the proposals related to the GDR issuance such as the Proposal on the Plan for GDR Issuance and Listing on SIX Swiss Exchange by the Company were deliberated  and  approved.  To  expand  the  Company's international  financing  channels,  satisfy  the need  for  international  business  development,  further  enhance  the  global  brand  influence,  and steadfastly promote the internationalization strategy, the Company planned to issue GDR and apply for  listing  on  SIX  Swiss  Exchange.  The  Company's  new  A-shares  would  be  the  underlying securities  for  the  GDR.  With  the  approval  of  the  CSRC  and  approval  of  the  relevant  Swiss regulatory authorities, the Company initially issued 28,184,100 GDRs and over-alloted 2,818,400 GDRs. The aforementioned GDRs, totaling 31,002,500 GDRs, corresponding to 310,025,000 shares

of the underlying securities of new A-shares, were respectively listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange on July 28, 2022 (CEST) and August 26, 2022 (CEST), raising a total of USD381 million. Upon completion of the issuance and the exercise of the over-allotment option, the total share capital of the Company was changed from 4,783,522,257 shares to 5,093,547,257 shares, and the registered capital was changed from RMB4,783,522,257 to RMB5,093,547,257.

The Company held the Fifth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and the Fourth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Supervisors on May 17, 2022 and the Third Extraordinary General Meeting of 2022 on June 6, 2022, at which the Proposal on the 2022 Restricted Share Incentive Plan (Draft) and Its Summary and other proposals related to the Share Incentive Plan were deliberated and approved. On July 18, 2022, the Company held the Eighth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and the Seventh Meeting of the Sixth Board of Supervisors, at which the Proposal on Adjusting Matters Related  to  the  Company's  2022  Restricted  Share  Incentive  Plan  and  the  Proposal  on  Granting Restricted Shares for the First Time to Incentive Recipients were deliberated and approved. A total of 42,039,300 restricted shares were determined to be granted to 677 incentive recipients at a price of  RMB3.641  per  share,  with  July  18,  2022  as  the  initial  grant  date.    In  accordance  with  the provisions of the Administrative Measures for Equity Incentive of Listed Companies of the CSRC, and  the  relevant  rules  of  the  Shenzhen  Stock  Exchange,  and  Shenzhen  Branch  of  the  China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited, the Company completed the registration of the initial grant of the Restricted Share Incentive Plan and the restricted shares initially granted were listed on September 2, 2022. Upon completion of the registration of the initial grant, the total share capital of the Company was changed from 5,093,547,257 shares to 5,135,586,557 shares, and the registered capital was changed from RMB5,093,547,257 to RMB5,135,586,557.

## XVII. Significant Matters of the Company's Subsidiaries

##  Applicable □Not applicable

On 12 August 2022, the Company held the Ninth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors and the Eighth Meeting of the Sixth Board of Supervisors, at which the Proposal on the Holding Subsidiary Terminating the Spin-off and Listing on the Growth Enterprise Market. Based on the fact that the Company's holding subsidiary Jiangxi Green Recycling Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Green Recycling") had a short time from the spin-off and reorganization of its E-waste business to the  listing  application  and  the  fact  that  Green  Recycling  had  less  than  two  years  of  independent operation after its spin-off and reorganization, Green Recycling believed that the current conditions for continuing the spin-off and listing were insufficient and the Company decided to terminate the spin-off and listing to develop Green Recycling's E-waste recycling and reuse business with more sufficient  time  and  in  a  looser  environment,  further  consolidate  Green  Recycling's  independent operation, further strengthen and improve the new business model driven by E-waste recycling and dismantling  as  well  as  by  waste  plastic  recycling  and  comprehensive  utilization  of  waste  circuit boards,  and  enhance  business  competitiveness  and  profit  stability.  The  Company  will  coordinate and  arrange Green  Recycling's  spin-off and  listing based  on  factors such  as its business development  and  the  external  environment  of  the  capital  market,  subsequently  finding  another opportunity to launch the spin-off and listing of Green Recycling.

## 2. Changes of restricted shares
